posts.title: 4 Best Features Of Brazilian Chestnut
posts.h1: 4 Best Features Of Brazilian Chestnut

blocks.text: Also known as Sucupira, Tiete Chestnut, or Bowdichia SPP, Brazilian Chestnut is a stunning tropical hardwood that stands out for its impressive color.
The genuine tones and design of the wood provide an exotic and rustic look that matches perfectly with other wooden elements that may be in the room.

Its remarkable color has a rich reddish-brown, chocolate-brown, or light brown tone, which combines with some yellow and white shades, creating a beautiful blend of colors. This hardwood also has a medium to coarse texture with an interlocked grain, and with dark and warm undertones.

Brazilian chestnut is a very good choice for areas exposed to foot traffic, due to its hardness and durability. Thanks to its natural properties, it can be used in a variety of construction projects. And guess what?... We have it here at Brazilian Lumber ready to ship.

Let's start with some background information about this amazing wood. The Sucupira tree belongs to the Leguminous family. This tree can grow up to 150 feet tall and reach a diameter of 4 feet, and can be found in countries located in the Lower Amazon region, such as Venezuela, the Guianas, and Brazil.
Brazilian Chestnut is known as a very durable wood, primarily used for interior flooring, decking railways, ties, and heavy construction. It has a Janka hardness of 2,140 pounds.
This genuine tropical hardwood can be considered as an effective, affordable alternative when looking to build a deck with high resistance to shrinkage due to moisture changes.
An important fact about this wood is that It is harvested from responsibly managed forests to ensure the longevity of this natural resource.
As a company, we consider that it is very important to follow responsible forest management . And this is how we do it:

posts.title: The 8 Facts That Make Ipe The Preferred Choice For Popular Tourist Places
posts.h1: The 8 Facts That Make Ipe The Preferred Choice For Popular Tourist Places

blocks.text: Photo 1-Simbithi-06-Leveco-Architects

For extraordinary constructions, you can count on the best wood in town, and that is Ipe. This one-of-a-kind hardwood has some outstanding characteristics and even more amazing natural properties. It is as hard as it is beautiful, making it the number one choice for luxury tourist resorts.

Its characteristics are hardness, resistance to weathering, insect damage, rot, and non-thermal conducting (stays cool in the sun). As well as its A1 fire rating and the fact that it can last more than 70 years, make it the preferred choice for some of the world's most popular tourist places.
You may find us saying that no wood compares to Ipe time and time again, but seriously, there are not enough words to describe all that this wood has to offer.
Here at Brazilian Lumber we pride ourselves on having the best tropical hardwoods in the world, with Ipe being the species that tops the list for its characteristics, quality, and beauty.
Before pointing out a list of some popular touristic places that use this wood, let us remind you of those extraordinary qualities that make it such a premium hardwood:
1. Ipe Is Weather & Water-Resistant
Ipe comes from the rainforest of the Americas, where it is exposed to a lot of rain and harsh sun. Thanks to its natural environment, it can withstand bad weather or other threats that surround it .

Its origin has made it the hardest and most durable wood in the world. Its density and natural oils make it impenetrable to almost everything. It also does not splinter or scratch easily and has a high coefficient of friction for safe use.
In addition, Ipe is one of the few natural building materials that can withstand saltwater corrosion. Therefore, it is the preferred choice for seaside constructions.
2. Ipe Does Not Heat Up In The Sun
This is quite an awesome feature. Ipe's surface will not burn your feet , so choosing it for pool decking sounds like a good idea.

First, it is important to understand that under the sun, the surface of your deck will heat up more depending on how thermally conductive a material is. Plastics and metals or their combination with wood become very hot in the sun.
Wood on the other hand is not a thermally conductive material. Another thing to keep in mind is that the darker the color of the surface, the more heat is absorbed and the hotter it gets.

Therefore, it is important to select the right type of material for areas constantly exposed to sunlight. With this wood, you get a material that always retains the cool factor throughout its surface.
3. Ipe Has An A1 Fire Rating
This characteristic makes Ipe similar to concrete and steel, as it also resists fire and heat.
This makes this wood a good surface to place a grill on. It's also a great choice for drought- and fire-prone areas, as it creates some insulation for the house.
4. The Longevity Of Ipe

Can you imagine buying a material that can last in perfect condition for more than 70 years? Ipe is that kind of material. When it comes to longevity, this wood meets the highest and most exquisite expectations for any project you have in mind.
This wood is known as "tough as nails" because it is one of the densest types of wood in the world. The surface of this wood is naturally resistant to the elements, mold, mildew, and insect damage.
5. Ipe Is A Safe Material

This is an important characteristic when choosing a material for your constructions. Most people don't follow this recommendation until an accident happens, and as we always say: 'It is better to be safe than sorry'.
Ipe is one of the safest decking materials on the market . Its high coefficient of friction makes it super slip-resistant even when the surface is wet.
6. Ipe Is Free Of Chemicals

Ipe wood is completely natural and does not require any chemical treatment or corrosive sanding process. This means that this hardwood does not emit harmful chemicals, and does not become plastic waste after its useful life.
Its natural oils make it resistant to fungus, mildew, and insect damage without the need to add any chemicals to preserve it or increase its durability.
7. Ipe Equals Luxury And Beauty
Nothing beats the warm and elegant touch that wood provides to your spaces. Besides its beauty, Ipe is also a practical, safe material, with a very long lifespan. What else could you ask for?

You can take advantage of its gorgeous color that goes from reddish brown to a more yellowish olive brown or darker blackish brown. It can also acquire a color known as silver patina, when no oil is applied to preserve its natural color. Either way, its appearance is very attractive.
8. Ipe Is A Low Maintenance Material
Sometimes, the worst thing about high-quality products is complicated and costly maintenance. With Ipe this is not a problem.

One of the best things about Ipe is that it does not require a time-absorbing cleaning routine with expensive products to keep it in top condition. Regular cleaning and the application of a proper oil (if you want to preserve its color) is enough.
Here is our 3 tips guide for proper maintenance:

items: Sweep it daily to remove dirt, pollen, and leaves
Wash it and let it dry well for at least 24 hours
Then oil it with proper products like the ones we sell here at Brazilian Lumber

Ipe Lumber Does Not Get Hot Underfoot

posts.h1: Top 5 Of The Best Hardwoods For Building Beach Houses

blocks.text: Seawater and harsh sun can be a hazard to some construction materials. Both elements can severely damage some surfaces in no time. That is why it is very important to make a proper decision on what material you should buy to build a house near the beach. Hardwoods, for instance, could be a good choice.

Hardwoods are the most widely used building material throughout history. Thanks to the natural oils they have and the incredible characteristics they share, it is not hard to understand why wood is still the preferred choice for beach house construction.
Let's start with some general information about hardwoods before naming the species Brazilian Lumber recommends most for seaside projects.

Tropical hardwoods have natural oils that make them impenetrable to insects, as well as resistant to rot, mold, water, and weathering. In addition, they are non-toxic, strong, low-maintenance, and durable materials.
Plus, there is always the factor of elegance, warmth, sophistication, and good taste that only wood can provide to your spaces.

With the experience and knowledge in the wood industry that we have here at Brazilian Lumber, let us give you this recommendation. If you are looking to build a house next to the beach, go for a wood choice. Here is a list of the BEST options :

items: Ipe
Cumaru
Teak
Garapa
Jatoba

blocks.text: Any of these tropical hardwoods will make the most of your outdoor spaces. They will create an extension of the living room, where you can have parties or family reunions in a relaxed area, enjoying nature, the weather, and the sunset.

Just imagine having a beautiful deck that won't be damaged by sand, moisture, or salt, typical of a beach environment. You won't need to worry about repairs or costly maintenance, plus you will have a safe, ecological surface that is pet and child-friendly.

Want more reasons to prefer hardwoods for your coastal construction? Here they are. With hardwoods, it is not just about functionality and good features, it's about aesthetics, good taste, and sophistication.
The way wood enhances every place by giving it style, character, and warmth is not comparable to any other building material. And that is a fact.
1. Hardwoods: Ipe Is The Best Choice
Withstanding the humidity, salt, and sand of the beach weather requires a material with some special characteristics. Ipe wood is the BEST alternative among tropical hardwoods, and here is why.

This amazing hardwood, sometimes called Brazilian Walnut, comes from South America and is the hardest tropical wood in the world. Its density and natural oils make it practically impervious to insects, or any sort of deterioration.

Ipe wood has great resistance to water and weathering, does not scratch or splinter easily, does not heat up in the sun, and has a high coefficient of friction. And this is just to name a few of its features that make it perfect for outdoor and coastal construction.
Also, Ipe is seawater-resistant, which means you won't have to worry about corrosion damage to your deck, as long as it's made of Ipe.
Actually, this is the most important reason why Ipe is the preferred choice for resort construction throughout the Caribbean. For example, the Conrad Resort in Bora Bora.

Last but not least, Ipe can last for more than 50 years in optimal condition with minimal maintenance. The only thing that may happen is a change of color into a silver-tone if you don't apply oil to the wood from time to time.
If you want to preserve the natural color of your Ipe wood, apply any of the oils we offer at Brazilian Lumber, especially our premium product: Easy oil , which provides protection against UV rays.
2. Hardwoods: Cumaru's High Quality And Durability
Cumaru is a beautiful wood that grows in the dense forests of Brazil. Among its many advantages, this hardwood has a very high rating in terms of durability, workability, and quality.
It has many similarities with Ipe wood. Both species are widely used for outdoor construction due to the amazing features that make them resistant to external factors, insect damage, and mildew.

Like Ipe, Cumaru also lasts for decades due to its natural oils that make it such a strong, dense hardwood. It also does not scratch or splinter easily, does not heat up in the sun, and has a high coefficient of friction.
Both Ipe and Cumaru are considered premium woods that meet high-quality standards that cannot be compared to other species.

Because of Cumaru wood's high durability and economical price, it's well-suited for high traffic decks and major commercial developments. It's also a smart option for beach projects, as it has a life expectancy of more than 50 years and is resistant to external hazards.
3. Hardwoods: Teak Is Supremely Water-Resistant
This wood is considered THE sea-resistant wood per excellence due to its extraordinary capacity not to rot even when constantly exposed to water.

Teak contains natural vegetable oils that make it extremely resistant to water as well as to termites and insects. In the naval field, It is probably known as the strongest hardwood. In fact, it is the preferred choice for shipbuilding thanks to its rot-resistance.
It is also an excellent choice for small outdoor construction such as furniture, patios, flooring, and other projects where the beauty of the wood should be as loud as the craftsmanship.

One of the most outstanding features of teak is its ability to withstand any weather. It is one of the few types of wood in the world that contains a natural oil that repels water and prevents it from warping or cracking.
This natural oil also helps Teak resist the harsh effects of torrential rains, severe winter snowstorms, and scorching sun.
4. Hardwoods: Garapa Is A Durable And Easy To Work With Material
Garapa's most important strengths are durability and workability. This gorgeous hardwood is the perfect alternative for any sort of outdoor project.
It is water, decay, and mold resistant. In addition, it can withstand extreme weather conditions, and this includes being exposed to seawater and harsh sun.

Garapa wood's water-resistant grain keeps moisture out, naturally prevents rot and decay, and creates a pool-friendly surface. The density of this wood also keeps insects like termites away, extending the life of your deck.
5. Hardwoods: Jatoba Is A Tough Wood

Commonly known as Brazilian cherry, Jatoba is one of the best tropical hardwoods there is. It is weather and rot-resistant and can't be damaged by any insect infestation. It is another perfect choice to build a house near the sea.

What makes it a tough wood is its origin. Jatoba comes from the forests of Central and South America, where it tolerates harsh weather conditions. It is also a long-lasting material you will be able to enjoy for an endless time.

In short, if you are looking for the best construction material for a project near the beach, hardwoods are all you need. Ipe, Cumaru, Teak, Garapa, and Jatoba are the species that we most recommend due to their natural properties and incredible features.
With these amazing tropical hardwoods, you won't have to worry about corrosion, insect, weather, or water damage as they are resistant to all of these hazards.
By choosing hardwoods, you will get a long-lasting, beautiful, and functional material to enjoy for decades. What more could you ask for!

posts.h1: Top 8 Of The Best Drills And How To Use Them

blocks.text: Building a hardwood deck can be overwhelming at times, especially if you don't have a clue about the hardware you need for it. Luckily, the Brazilian Lumber team is here to give a list of the 8 most recommended drills you can use for an easier and smarter installation procedure.

When we say hardware , we mean all the accessories you may need for your buildings and remodeling around the house. Any installation process requires screws, nails, hammers, connectors, fasteners, and drills. This last tool is kind of an important one.

In this article, we are going to focus on the variety of these on the market and how to use each of them. Trust us, it is always important to have an expert's opinion when it comes to drills. So, let's get started.

Drills are rotated by a press and fed to a stationary workpiece. Some types of machines have a stationary drill that may feed a rotating workpiece, or the material and workpiece may rotate in opposite directions.

So, as you see, there can be many types of these that you can work with, so it is important to know which ones are the most recommended. In addition, it is necessary to know how to use each of them, so you can identify which one meets your needs.

In addition to turning it bit for drilling, screwing, or other functions, some offer a hammering action to concrete. There are others that can make boreholes and drive screws in places where a screwdriver won't even fit.
There is a wide variety of drills on the market. So, here is a list of the best options to consider for a home construction or remodeling job.

items: 3-in-1 Decking Kit
Hand
Corded
Cordless
Hammer
Impact driver
Right-Angle
Drill press

blocks.text: 1. 3-in-1 Decking Drill Kit

The Drill & Drive™ is a 3-in-1 tool you can use to pre-drill, countersink, then flip to insert and drive screws into decking. The ease of use makes pre-drilling hardwoods and installing deck screws 3 times faster than standard drilling & driving.

You know what the best part is? This super tool kit is available here at Brazilian Lumber. Thanks to our incredible partner, DeckWise , we are able to offer this amazing 3-in1 tool that will make the building process a piece of cake!
This tool kit includes a screw gun tip, a hex key, and locking set screws. So you can pre-drill, countersink, and drive screws into the deck. Three functions in just one device.
2. A Hand Drill For Smooth Operation

Hand drills are the most basic format of these tools. They are commonly used for lighter jobs, for example, those that require gentle, handcrafted work. They are the preferred choice for jewelers and electronics technicians.
These are highly rated for work that requires great precision. They usually come with multiple-purpose bits.
3. A Corded Drill For Tough Work
Nowadays, almost all samples from this tool are cordless, but the corded version is still on the market as it is the best choice for tough jobs that require extra power.

Corded provide the power you need for a tedious installation process. They develop superior torque for driving. They are also suitable for heavy-duty bits, and the removable handle allows you to leverage them for pressing into a dense material.
4. Cordless Drill, A Lighter And Portable Choice
These can do almost everything their corded version does, and they are also lighter and more portable. Their advantage may be the multiple options they offer.
You can find them in a lightweight version for small jobs around the house, or in a stronger, more rugged version for heavy construction projects.
5. A Hammer Drill For Working With Concrete
Hammer drills are the best option for concrete, bricks, or blocks. This strong and powerful tool combines rotary and reciprocating action when in use.
What we mean by this is that a hammer creates an oscillating hammering action when the bit rotates. That is why this tool is the right alternative when working with strong materials such as concrete.
There is another version of this tool, and it's called the rotary hammer. Although they have almost the same name, they are not the same tool.
Both the hammer and the rotary hammer offer the same hammering action, but in the case of the hammer, the hammer action is produced by a piston in the shaft.
In addition, the rotary hammer works faster, and it is even stronger than the hammer. For instance, you can use it to fix concrete fasteners for retaining walls and fences.
6. An Impact Driver Is Not Technically A Drill

The recommendation is to use it exclusively for driving bolts, screws, or other fasteners available on the market. This tool provides the high torque needed to drive fasteners into hard, dense materials.

An impact driver has a spring-loaded clutch mechanism that periodically increases the torque of the bit. This is an advantage when driving long screws and retracting stuck ones, as it makes this job easier and faster.
7. Get Into Tight Spots With A Right-Angle Drill
Thanks to its peculiar shape, you can use it in places that are hard to reach. With the chuck facing perpendicular to the body, it is the perfect tool for getting into tight spots.

Use it for DIY electrical, plumbing, and carpentry work. For example, If you have to drill a hole in a cabinet wall for a new dishwasher drain line, this is the tool you need. Others will not let you do the job.
8. A Drill Press Gives More Stability
When you're looking for precision, a press is what you need. There are some materials, such as metal, that require a more precise movement, and the best thing for that is to use a stationary tool.
A press allows you to clamp down on the work and drill holes at precise locations while controlling the rotation speed. This makes operations meticulous and repeatable.

To conclude, if you are planning to build or remodel something around the house, you better use the proper tools . Pay attention to it because you may need according to the work you are going to do, and get amazing results.

When it comes to technical information, allow yourself to receive some advice to help you choose the right tool. Knowing all the options on the market, and how you can use them, will help you to do a good job.
And remember that the Brazilian Lumber team is always available to help you with knowledge and expertise in the construction field. Make your projects come true with our guide.

posts.title: The 5 Most Common Signs Of Rotten Wood
posts.h1: The 5 Most Common Signs Of Rotten Wood

blocks.text: Hardwoods are among the most resistant materials in the world. Their hardness and natural oils make them impenetrable to almost everything. That includes harsh weather, insect infestation, rotting issues, and other external factors.
For example, some tropical hardwood species such as Ipe , Cumaru , Jatoba , Garapa , and Tigerwood have these natural oils we are talking about, therefore they are tough woods.
In contrast, domestic or pressure-treated wood are easy targets for rotting . To maintain these materials in optimal condition, they need some attention and protection.

So with a regular cleaning routine , you will preserve them in top condition. Also, by cleaning it regularly it will be easier to identify the most common signs that your wood is rotting, so you can take immediate action.

No matter how tough the material you are using for your project, nature should never be challenged. It will always be best to know what to do in case one of the boards in your structure starts to rot. Don't you think?

Prevention is the key to avoiding this because rotting problems are not something to be taken lightly. Rotten can do severe damage to the whole structure and create hazardous conditions. Therefore, regularly checking your deck and deck structure is key.

First, it is important to understand that fungi, mold, and moisture buildup in places with a lack of air circulation, which tend to be damp and dark. Here are some examples of indoor and outdoor locations most prone to rot.

items: Window and exterior door frames
Kitchen cabinets
Deck and patio structures
Bathroom, and basement baseboards
Near gaps in exterior siding
Around bathtubs, showers, and pools

blocks.text: But why is it so important to know what to do about rotting issues? Because, if the rotten board is not removed, the damage can spread to the entire structure, and the repair will take longer.
Do You Know What It Means To Have Rotten Wood Problems?

The rotting is caused by a combination of water and fungal growth in the material itself. In this environment, there are some bacteria that grow to destroy other parts of it. If this damage is not stopped, the entire structure can be totally ruined.

In most cases of decayed material, the best solution is to get rid of the infected area. Then, cut out part of the surrounding wood region, clean the spot, allow it to dry properly, and replace the timber.

Sometimes, depending on the severity of the damage, you may need the help of a professional. Experts are trained to deal with insect infestation, fungal growth, deep cracks, accumulated water, and other issues that can cause it to rot.
Signs Of Rotten Wood

items: Exterior Damage Can Lead To Rotten Wood

blocks.text: Keep an eye on any cracks or holes that may appear in your boards. Why? Because those spots create the perfect opportunity for water seepage.

There are some signs that can tell you that your domestic or pressure-treated material has been exposed to water, for example, discoloration, shrinkage, or splintering. Any of these conditions cause these types of wood to become soft and dark. After a certain time, the wood will lose its ability to hold together and this will compromise the strength and support of the structure.
2. Rotten Wood Caused By Fungal & Spores Growth

If you found a spongy, gray-colored texture spot, that is a clear sign of fungi growing. On the other hand, spores are more noticeable as they show yellow, purple, or white patches around the affected area.
3. Musty Smells Are Also Signs Of Rotten Wood Issues
Always trust your sense of smell. When there is water damage or mold that can cause domestic or pressure-treated material to rot, a telltale odor is very noticeable in the environment.
As the fungus spreads and decays it, it produces a musty smell that is easy to detect in areas with minimal ventilation.
4. Rotten Wood Shows Discoloration

Most of the time, you may think that when you see the color fade, that is a sign of lack of maintenance and oil application. Sometimes it is, but the discoloration is also a sign of rotting problems. Any bubbling, blistering, cracking, or peeling of the paint should be a warning to you.
5. Rotten Wood Attracts Insects

Be aware of any insect activity because that indicates there may be an opening through which water can leak. This is kind of an important sign, not only because having insects such as termites or ants can damage the structure, but because insect infestation can be hard to control.
In addition, pests can create a new entry point for moisture and rot, and that can damage the whole structure in a short time.
Here is a bonus. Now that you know the signs that your wood is rotting, here are some quick tips to prevent it.

items: Make sure the wood structure has adequate ventilation when installed to prevent condensation and moisture.
Perform a regular cleaning routine to remove standing water, debris, and dust.
Repair cracks whenever you find one, as this can be a way for water to come in contact with the wood.

blocks.text: To conclude, if you detect any of these signs around your domestic or pressure-treated wood , it is time to start the healing process of your timber. Remove the rotten area, clean the surrounding region, and replace the boards to leave the structure as good as new.
To keep an eye on your wood structure, the best recommendation will always be a regular and proper cleaning routine. This will allow you to be more aware of the condition of your wood at all times.

posts.title: The 3 Best Woodworking Materials And Their Advantages
posts.h1: The 3 Best Woodworking Materials And Their Advantages

blocks.text: Choosing the best woodworking material is not going to be an easy task. There are plenty of woodworking materials on the market. Aside from being readily available, wood is an extraordinary material with great advantages and amazing properties.

Hardwood is an especially good choice for any outdoor building project. Not only because it is a hard, stunning, long-lasting material, but also because of the natural oils, it has. The oils make it resistant to most threats such as insect damage, weathering, water, and decay.

On top of that, there is the aesthetic factor. The variety of colors and textures that wood provides makes it suitable for any style. At Brazilian Lumber, we offer all types of hardwood such as Ipe , Cumaru, Jatoba , Garapa , and others that provide a variety of color options. Plus, you get a material that enhances any place with class, warmth, and elegance.

In addition, wood is one of the few natural and renewable building materials. As a purely natural product, it's not treated with chemicals or pollutants and is non-toxic, so it is safe to handle and touch. It also ages naturally and does not decompose into environmentally harmful material.

At Brazilian Lumber , we pride ourselves on providing only FSC-certified wood that comes from sustainably managed forests. This guarantees the preservation not only of the forest and its natural resource but also ensures responsible and consistent production .
All the hardwoods we have in stock are non-toxic products, suitable for children, and pets. Since they don't need any chemical product for their maintenance, they are also environmentally friendly.

Therefore, having a natural, renewable, recyclable, and biodegradable building material has many advantages. Here is a list of what we consider to be the most important benefits of choosing wood for your projects.

items: It is a carbon positive element.
Lumber absorbs sound instead of reflecting or amplifying it, and can help to significantly reduce the noise level for greater comfort.
Studies show that using lumber is healthier for people.

blocks.text: This last aspect is a unique characteristic of wood. Some research has shown that when people are surrounded by wooden elements or, better yet, structures, they get the same benefits of being in nature. Want to know what benefits we are referring to?

items: Improves mood and self-expression.
Upgrade air quality by moderating humidity. This also facilitates breathing.
Provides a warm and comfortable feeling.
Helps to reduce blood pressure, heart rate, and stress.

blocks.text: As you can see, buying wood and using it for your interior and exterior constructions offers many benefits. Do you know what the best part is? There are a variety of woodworking materials you can choose from. Here is a list of the 3 best woodworking materials we most recommend for your buildings:

items: Tropical Hardwoods
Softwoods
Wood Deck Tiles

blocks.text: 1. Best Woodworking Materials: Hardwoods
Hardwoods are our favorites. Most of them come from forests near the equator, which is a region with particular tropical weather with lots of rainfall and intense sun.

Since species such as Ipe , Cumaru , Jatoba , Garapa , and many others, come from trees that grow in harsh environments, they are used to dealing with complicated weather conditions. That is why they have developed natural properties which make them resistant to water, insect damage, decay, and even seawater.

In addition, hardwoods are long-lasting, low-maintenance materials that you will enjoy for a long time. They can also withstand high foot traffic. Can you believe it? It's as if nothing can beat the quality they have.

These natural properties and outstanding features make them the top option for outdoor construction. In fact, they are widely used as decking, siding, and especially for luxury properties. Here are the best tropical hardwood species we suggest for your projects.

items: Cumaru: This tropical hardwood is as extraordinary as Ipe. In many aspects, they have important similarities, especially in their features and quality.

blocks.text: Both are premium hardwoods , ideal for decking, siding, cladding, or any other project you have in mind.
Ipe and Cumaru are classified as very durable types of wood because of the natural oils that make them resistant to rot, mildew, and weathering.
In addition, their natural properties make them insect-resistant, and less prone to scratching or splintering.

As a premium wood that is more affordable than Ipe, it has come to be a sought-after option for customers. It is becoming ever more popular with architects and designers, especially because of its beautiful reddish color, which adds a level of warmth and depth to any project.

items: Garapa: This lumber is one of the best woods for decking. The workability of this tropical hardwood is highly praised. It tends to be more workable than the other hardwoods. It also boasts the same qualities as other hardwoods, such as robustness and resistance to extreme weather conditions. What sets Garapa apart is its beautiful golden tone.

blocks.text: In the last few years, Garapa has rapidly gained popularity with homeowners due to some of its best features. The most important of these characteristics are resistance to rot & insects, and the fact that it is a low-maintenance material.

items: Jatoba: With its beautiful deep reddish tones, Jatoba is a favorite of homeowners. Its remarkable properties and attractive appearance make it one of a kind. It is resistant to rot, weathering, and insect damage.

blocks.text: Yes, these kinds of properties are constantly repeated. Why? Because Jatoba is one of the top 5 best hardwoods in the world. As well as Ipe and Cumaru which are at the top of the list. Therefore, all of them share almost the same characteristics.

items: Teak: This is an exceptionally durable wood, known primarily for its resistance to water and wet climates, which is why it is used in shipbuilding. It contains natural vegetable oils that make it very resistant to pest infestation and to water, which is why it is considered the sea-resistant wood par excellence.

blocks.text: It's also a great choice for small outdoor projects like furniture, patios, flooring, and other structures where the beauty of the wood should be as loud as the craftsmanship. In fact, any yacht or boat you see with a wooden deck is most likely made of teak .

items: Oak: This hardwood has two varieties: the white and the red type. No matter the color, Oak is a heavy, strong hardwood with high resistance to fungus, yeast, and mildew.

blocks.text: It is known for its workability as it can be used for household and office furniture, like bookshelves and cabinets.
Nowadays, its popularity has increased and that is why some interior decor experts are using it for flooring. As well as veneers, and decorative wooden items.
2. Best Woodworking Materials: Softwoods

What is the difference between hardwoods and softwoods? There are a lot of common misconceptions about these two types of woods. Hardwoods are angiosperms, or blooming trees, while softwood trees are gymnosperms, which means that instead of flowers and bulbs, they have seeds or cones.

Even though hardwoods are more popular with builders and homeowners, softwoods also have nice features. For example, they have a faster growth rate. This means that they develop faster than hardwoods, which leads to lower-cost levels as they are easier to source.

They are also flexible, which makes them easy to work with. In addition, they can be used across a wide range of applications, such as building components for windows and doors, furniture, and even as Christmas decorations.

Now, it is important to explain why most people prefer hardwood to softwoods. Basically, softwood species will not last as long as hardwoods. In fact, their lifespan will last no more than 10 years, while with most hardwoods their lifespan is over 50 years.
There are many species of softwoods as well, but here is a list of the ones we consider the best options for your construction projects.

items: Pine: There are some pine varieties, here at Brazilian Lumber we offer Yellow Pine. Its high strength, stiffness, and appealing appearance make it one of the most important types of timber in the construction industry, among softwood species.

blocks.text: Yellow pine is very dense yet lightweight and resists warping. It is used to frame houses, for roofing, and more because it is so structurally sound.

items: Cedar: This softwood has the advantage of being a very stable material. In addition, it has natural phenol that preserves it from moisture, decay, and insect damage.

blocks.text: Another great trait is that it is not prone to expansion, even with temperature changes, nor to twisting, cupping, or cracking. Cedar is prized because it is an excellent base for paints and stains. It is also termite resistant and lightweight.
These characteristics make cedar easy to work with and reliable in both outdoor and indoor applications such as paneling, furniture, lining drawers, chests, and boxes.

items: California Redwood: It is considered a premium building material because it is relatively durable outdoors and yet easy to work. It is usually used outdoors, for example for decks, but can also be used in flooring or furniture for the interior.

blocks.text: Redwood is also an excellent choice for garden borders and retaining walls due to its moisture resistance property.

items: Douglas Fir: This softwood is considered a unique sample due to its very large size. Also, it is a very heavy, dense, and strong material, yet easy to work with.

blocks.text: Douglas Fir is a highly valued wood for building exterior structures because it is almost knot-free and can be sewn to great lengths. It can be used as pergolas, telephone poles, and railroad sleepers. In addition, it is one of the most structurally sound softwoods available.
3. Best Woodworking Materials: Deck Tiles

Looking for a quick and easy installation system to improve some areas of your home? Using deck tiles is the right way to go. As simple as putting a puzzle together, you have a completely renovated area in no time that will remain in excellent condition with minimal maintenance.

Contrary to what you may have heard, not all types of tiles require skill, time, or even a convenient location for laying. Deck tiles are a consumer-friendly option that comes in a convenient interlocking format that will make your life easier.

Here at Brazilian Lumber, we have pre-assembled tiles made of attractive and durable Brazilian hardwood, such as Ipe and Cumaru. Deck tiles can be easily placed over a variety of surfaces to create decks, paths, or even a dance floor.
Deck tiles are typically made up of planks of wood but can be manufactured from other materials as well. They normally come in a large size and square shape - either 20x20 or 24x24.

This is definitely an amazing woodworking material, and guess what? Our Ipe tiles are available with a smooth finish or with an anti-slip surface that is very suitable for applications near swimming pools or outdoor showers.

To conclude, wood is always the right material to make your dream projects a reality. Its natural properties and amazing features make it a superior choice on many levels that is hard to resist from it.

In addition, you can choose from a variety of species not only of hardwoods but also softwoods and wood deck tiles. Each of them offers different features that will allow you to decide according to your needs.

posts.title: NADRA's Best 8 Recommendations For Deck Building
posts.h1: NADRA's Best 8 Recommendations For Deck Building

blocks.text: Photo 1-Capella Sanya Resort

Having a wooden deck in the backyard provides a space to enjoy with family and friends. It gives the outdoor area a gathering place that will be surrounded by your loved ones most of the time. For that matter, it is necessary to consider the most important recommendations when building one.

We are glad to share some important considerations that the North American Decking and Railing Association (NADRA) recommends to ensure the security and longevity of decks. This article will not provide a step-by-step guide to building a material but will advise you on things to consider when planning out a deck .

NADRA is the voice of the decking industry in the United States. This association represents the builders, technical inspectors, and manufacturers. Its mission is to provide certain information for the professional development, promotion, growth, and sustenance of the deck and railing building business in North America.

Based on some research about accidents on old ones that are no longer in good condition, the association established some recommendations. Why? To encourage homeowners to build not only beautiful but safe decks. And here they are:
1. When Building A Deck, Pay Attention To Split Or Decaying Wood

Rot is a problem that mostly affects soft or pressure-treated wood. So if you are using these types of wood instead of tropical hardwood species that are rot & insect-resistant, this is a recommendation to pay attention.
Make sure that the fasteners from the ledger board, posts, and joints under the material are well attached and in good condition. This means checking if any of them are rusted or loose.

Pay special attention to those areas that are typically damp or prone to get wet. If you find spongy spots across the surface or inside the wood, decay may be present. In addition, insect infestation can also cause rotting problems.
2. Flashing Is A Helpful Tool When Building A Deck

What is such a thing as flashing? It is a metal or plastic alert item that keeps water away from sensitive areas of your wooden material. This item is often installed where the wood and house come together. You can choose the DeckWise joist tape that we sell, which is a type of flashing.

Here at Brazilian Lumber , we consider this recommendation as an alternative to protect your wooden structure from rotting if you are using domestic or pressure-treated wood, but not the only one. However, NADRA is the expert association when it comes to building one, so this advice is worth being told.
3. Be Careful With Loose or Corroded Fasteners Around Your Deck

NADRA's most important recommendation is to give special attention to fasteners. These connectors must be always tight so the structure remains safe . If you find any rusted fastener, replace it immediately.
This last piece of advice is crucial for safety purposes to avoid the deterioration of the entire wood due to corrosion damage.
4. Railings And Fences Should Be Firmly Attached To The Deck

There is nothing better than enjoying the sunset view while standing on your wooden material without being at risk of falling. It is essential to be sure that railings and banisters are firmly held to the structure. This is particularly relevant the higher your material is off the ground, especially if children are around.
5. Clean And Give Proper Maintenance To Your Deck

Having a regular cleaning routine is always a good recommendation for the proper maintenance of your wooden deck. NADRA's suggestion is to clear the surface from debris, leaves, and dust. Then clean it (it doesn't specify any product) and finally apply a new waterproof coating.

If you have any doubts, you can always call Brazilian Lumber, and we can make recommendations. We generally tell clients to use a cleaning solution of one quart of bleach mixed with one gallon of warm water. Then let the structure dry for at least 24 hours, and finally, apply a special oil to the surface.
Check our website for our maintenance combo . We offer an oil, a sealer, a brightener, and a cleaner that will leave your wood shiny, clean, and protected.
6. Be Careful With Flammable Items Around The Deck

Sometimes, in order to improve the atmosphere around the new deck, people use grills, fire pits, chimneys, or candles, which are flammable items. If you consider letting yourself be carried away by a romantic design, make sure any source of fire or heat is safely placed. Always use caution and follow manufacturers' directions.
Also, if you are using gas, please be sure you check local building codes and regulations.
7. Lighting And Electrical Around The Deck
Be sure all lighting is working; clean light covers to shine maximum light, and trim any plants or tree branches that may block it.
Also, make sure that all electrical outlets, appliances, and features are up to code, in good condition, and childproof if present.
Ensure that electrical cables are not a tripping hazard or are not exposed to water. This could lead to electrical damage.
8. Pay Attention To The Trees Surrounding The Deck
It's always lovely to be surrounded by nature, but make sure that any new place in the house offers a safe space to be.
If you have trees overhanging your deck, make sure there is no danger of decaying branches breaking off and falling from the surrounding trees.

In short, there are many things you should consider when building a deck. There are technical recommendations, decoration suggestions, and general tips like these from NADRA that will make your life easier and your deck safer.

Our live edge slabs are very versatile too. You can use it as tabletops, barn-style doors, rustic headboards, decorative art pieces, or as a floating shelf.

Since there are many slab pieces, you can sometimes feel overwhelmed when deciding which one to buy. This article can be really useful for those looking for a stunning slab who don't know where to start. Here are the 5 things we consider you should know before investing in a piece.
1. Slabs Should Be Dried And Finished
If you are buying large live edge slabs, make sure each piece is properly dried. Why? Because this will provide more dimensional stability to the wood piece.
Wood tends to shrink depending on the species the slab comes from. With hardwoods, you won't need to worry about that, but width and thick reduction may be an issue with other species.
Likewise, if you are looking for a smoother and more durable surface, prefinished slabs are the right choice. A polished product means more usable material that will be easy to work with.
The slabs we have right now ready to ship accomplish these two specifications. Our pieces are made from Tigerwood and Angelim Pedra. Both in a variety of sizes to meet your needs.

Tigerwood is an exotic type of hardwood that has a distinctive light golden-brown to reddish-brown coloring with exotic black and brown streaks. Therefore, its color gives the wood such a unique appearance.

This amazing hardwood has a non-preservative lifespan of over 30 years, does not mold or mildew, and is sustainably harvested. In fact, all our hardwoods come from sustainable forest management and are FSC certified.

With Angelim Pedra wood, the color is also a factor that stands out. It varies from tan to yellow, with vertical stripes in dark red and brown shades. It is also very durable and resistant to dry-wood termites. Plus, it is a very affordable option.
2. Make Up Your Mind About The Number Of Slabs You Need

Making smart purchases means having a clear idea of the project you want to build. So after choosing the type of slab, decide how many pieces you need. This really depends on what you are building or remodeling and your design preferences.
If you are looking for one piece, you must have a clear idea of your space to place it. This will make you buy the piece with the right dimensions.
Now, if the space where you are doing your building project is ample, maybe three or four pieces of slab furniture are the right ones to get stunning results.
As if these two recommendations were not helpful, knowing the slab pieces you need for your project will make you realize the budget you actually need for it.
3. What Slabs Do You Want? Thick Or Thin?
The thinner the milled wood, the more likely your sharp-edged table will be prone to warping and twisting.

Shop at places with the knowledge and experience to properly guide you through your project. Here at Brazilian Lumber, we believe that live edge slabs should be at least three inches thick. This will allow the slab to resist some changes that may occur during the drying process.
4. Live Edge Slabs Maintenance
Some articles agree on recommending two products for the proper maintenance of your slabs. This being lacquer and oil. We are more in favor of using oil.

Both products have different effects after application. For example, lacquer is applied to the wood surface, sealing it. Whereas oil goes through the inside of the wood grain, strengthening the timber fibers.

A lacquered surface will be easier to maintain as you clean a sealed cover in the short to medium term. On the other hand, oiled live edge furniture will require a little more maintenance, as the oil must be replenished periodically.

But why do we recommend the use of oils? For us, applying oil to the surface of the slab is a more natural way to maintain this type of furniture. Oils are less invasive products, although they have a more substantial effect.
That is why we always suggest the use of oils on hardwood structures. Oils are subtle products that preserve the natural state of the wood, giving it an incredible shine.

Long story short, be sure you have a clear idea of the project you want to build before purchasing. If you are looking for a live edge slab, prefer a dry, finished piece that will provide a polished surface that is easier to care for and better to show off.

Don't forget to measure the space where you'll be placing the new live edge piece, so you know how many you'll need. And be careful how thick each slab should be. At Brazilian Lumber, we will be thrilled to guide you with everything you may need for your purchase.

posts.title: To Have A Pests-free Wooden Deck, Try These 7 Top Secrets
posts.h1: To Have A Pests-free Wooden Deck, Try These 7 Top Secrets

blocks.text: If your deck is made of hardwood, this article is not for you . Hardwoods have natural oils that make them resistant to insect infestation, so your material is automatically pests-free. But suppose it is made of domestic or pressure-treated wood. In that case, this information is very useful in keeping insects away from the structure .
If you want to avoid insect rot, mildew, or mold, you have two great options: a hardwood or a composite or PVC. Choosing either option will prevent you from having to deal with insects.

However, keep in mind that the best way to avoid dealing with this hazard is to choose an exotic tropical hardwood to build the new deck. The species we most suggest are Ipe , Cumaru , Garapa , and Jatoba . They all are the best types of hardwoods, with amazing properties and incredible features which make them impervious to any external damage.

Now, if you were not warned about this and chose the wrong material to build your deck, you will get rid of insects with these recommendations. You will finally be able to enjoy being outdoors without the presence of mosquitos, flies, and other pests.
1. Regularly Clean Your Deck
This is a recommendation you should follow regardless of the type of material your wood is made of. Having a cleaning routine is always a great way to preserve your structures.
The slightest spill or crumb of food on your wood can serve as an invitation for pests. If you don't want to be visited by ants, a proper and frequent cleaning routine is a must.

Sweeping your wood and cleaning up spills from it every day will allow you to have more control of its good maintenance and cleanliness. And, of course, you will be reducing the chances of attracting insects.
Here is a 3-step guide for a perfect cleaning routine. Typically, we recommend these steps for hardwood decking maintenance. Still, you can also try it with your domestic or pressure-treated wood:

items: Sweep it and remove dirt, dust, and leaves from its surface.
Clean it using a special solution made with a quart of bleach and a gallon of warm water. Then let your wood dry for at least 24 hours.
You can apply oil to your wood decking to prevent color fading.

blocks.text: 2. Fill The Gaps In Your Deck

Any crack or hole underneath your deck gives insects and rodents the opportunity to create nests in the warm, quiet, and dark spaces between boards. Once they build a home there, you could end up having to pull the whole structure apart to solve the problem.
To avoid that disaster, look for any cracks appearing and repair them immediately. As we always say, prevention is always the solution.
3. Set Up Citronella Candles Around Your Deck

Here's a homemade solution. An hour or maybe half hour before going outdoors, light citronella candles around the perimeter of your deck. This will help you repel flies, mosquitos, and other pests from your outdoor area.
Find the right spot to put these candles in order to really protect the surrounding field and use the proper candle holders to avoid accidents.
You can also spray your deck with essential oils. Like lavender and eucalyptus, some of them may help prevent insect bites.
This recommendation is also good if your deck is made of composite material. You can also put tiki torches and blue lights to kill mosquitoes.
4. Get Rid Of Standing Water On Your Deck

Again, with hardwoods, you won't have this problem ever as they are water-resistant. But, if your deck is made with domestic or pressure-treated wood, pay important attention to this recommendation. Water can rot wood , and rotten wood can lead to an insect infestation.
Standing water attracts insects, especially mosquitoes. We can imagine how terrible it can be not to be able to enjoy summertime on your deck because of the presence of mosquitoes ready to bite you.

The best way to eradicate this problem is to get rid of the stagnant water around the deck. Then fill all spaces with stones or extra soil as they can end up with water again. You can also be more sophisticated and use a drainage system to draw the water away from your deck.
5. Install Lighting Around Your Deck

Installing lights around your deck can be tricky, as many of them end up attracting insects instead of repelling them. Luckily, we are here to help you choose the proper lighting to get rid of insects.
If you have a severe mosquito problem, we suggest using a bug zapper light. But if you are looking for a more subtle option, some yellow bug lights can be enough.
These bulbs have a lower temperature than regular ones and therefore don't attract insects. They will provide good illumination as well.
6. Choose The Proper Herbs And Flowers For Your Deck

Some species of plants and herbs can help keep pests away - for example, garlic, rosemary, chive, and lemongrass. You can plant some flowers that will also be useful in eradicating insect infestation problems, such as Marigold.
Best of all, in addition to how useful these plants and flowers are in combating insects, they can also enhance the area by bringing life, color, and scents to your deck.
7. Seek Professional Help To Save Your Deck
Sometimes, no matter how hard you try to fight the insect infestation, pests will remain where they are. And when this happens, it is time to seek professional help .
Doing things right also means making them on time. It's ok to try to solve the problem yourself, but don't wait until your deck is completely ruined to call in the experts.
Seek the services of pest control companies and call them right away. They will help you eliminate your insect infestation problem once and for all.

To conclude, if you have a deck made of domestic or pressure-treated wood instead of hardwood, you may end up suffering from insect infestation around your outdoor area. To avoid this problem, we recommend a regular cleaning routine, the use of plants and flowers to help keep them away, as well as some lights or essential oils that also help repel insects.

We suggest not doing some other things, like leaving standing water around your deck and not repairing cracks or holes in the structure. Both of these mistakes will definitely provide insects with the perfect nesting environment.
And last but not least, if you are suffering from a severe insect infestation problem, do not hesitate to call for professional help. Please do not wait until it's too late.

blocks.text: Having a pleasant and comfortable backyard where you can kick off summer sounds like the perfect plan to enjoy your free time. In addition, being able to make the most of the new outdoor area by getting together with friends is an extra benefit of having a patio or deck. You can even play sports in a natural and open space. Cool, right?

The first step in renovating your outdoor area is choosing the right materials. Of course, at Brazilian Lumber , we have no doubt that the most suitable choice will always be Ipe wood . This extraordinary tropical hardwood is the best in the world.
Ipe is a remarkable hardwood with a gorgeous appearance and incredible characteristics that surpass all other types of wood and materials on the market.
Let's review some features that make Ipe such a great option and the perfect material for building a deck around the pool area or for the afternoon barbecue.

Ipe is known for its hardness, resistance to weathering, insect damage, rot, and mildew. It won't get hot underfoot and is also resistant to saline water. In addition, it has an A1 fire rating and can last more than 70 years with minimal maintenance.

We offer other extraordinary hardwoods suitable for exterior construction, such as Cumaru , Garapa , Jatoba , and Tigerwood . These hardwoods are also premium alternatives for your building projects, but Ipe will always be the best choice for a deck as far as stability and longevity.

Besides Ipe's amazing properties, the wood itself provides all you need to enjoy your outdoor space. It will not splinter or heat up in the sun, making it perfect for walking on with bare feet. It also does not scratch very easily, making it safe for furniture.

Additionally, it does not let mildew, mold, or insect penetrate it, so it keeps its integrity for many years. It also gives the area a touch of stylish sophistication and comfortable warmth. Its coloring, durability, and how it can fit with all kinds of design preferences make it the best option to improve your home.

We want to help you get ready for summer by building the coolest backyard ever to enjoy with friends and family. So here are the 8 most incredible ideas for a renovation that will leave everyone breathless.
1. Improve Your Deck With A Pergola

Building a pergola is a perfect idea if you want to have a sort of oasis in the middle of your backyard. Besides being an element that brings good decorative taste to the area, it is a bright place to start your mornings.

A pergola can have multiple uses. The most common reason for installing a pergola is to provide shade. The lattices allow for air to flow and can serve as trellises for vines. The best part of the pergola is that it can go directly over your deck, protecting it from UV rays.
This element will give you the feeling of having a private open-air place in the middle of your backyard. It will be like having a small island where you can escape stress and hustle.
2. Garden Beds And Benches For The Deck

Having an outdoor area is getting a spot to enjoy nature and being surrounded by flowers and greenery. Make the most beautiful garden beds and benches with Ipe wood. Let your creativity go wild and build some hybrids that are seating and planters at the same time.

You can make some incredible planters using Ipe shorts . These short lengths of Ipe have all the same properties as the larger board lengths, but are easier to handle, very adaptable, versatile, and have a lower price point.

Here at Brazilian Lumber, we carry this material in more dimensions than most lumberyards. We have ipe boards for decking, ipe beams, and much more. Also, we offer Ipe shorts in the following measurements: 1X6 - 2X4 - 2X2 - 2X6.
3. Turn The Deck Into A Beautiful Harbor

Using Ipe for a harborside deck and dock is ideal for a variety of reasons. It is a natural material that has not been treated with chemicals, which means there is no risk of contaminating the ocean or lake. It is not likely to splinter, check, or warp, despite being exposed to constant moisture. Likewise, it is not a heat-absorbing material, which means stepping off of your boat barefoot will cause no discomfort.

Of course, we recommend Ipe for the decking, as it is a low-maintenance material capable of withstanding external hazards. We recommend you check your local code to see what railing requirements are for your specific area to make your deck safer for your children and pets.
Expand the living room of your house by creating a backyard that is this beautiful and useful. The key is always to build with a purpose.
4. A Hardwood Deck For The Pool In The Backyard

Ipe decking is a must if you have a pool area in your backyard. Why? Because for an area prone to get wet, you need a strong material. A deck around the pool will constantly be exposed to water and sunlight, so you need a very resistant material that is also slip-resistant. The last thing you want is a slippery surface, which means hardwood is the choice for you! In fact, we can even mill special slip-proof profiles.
It is because of these features that we stand behind our Barefoot Promise. Zero foot damage on a surface that will provide years of enjoyment for you and your loved ones.
Enjoy the summer without worrying about burning or injuring your feet while tanning or taking a dip in the water. You won't have to deal with rot, either, as Ipe is also resistant to it.
Also, consider using Ipe wood around the hot tub. In addition to its amazing features, which are very useful around a place prone to getting wet, you provide sophistication and style to the area.
6. Provide Wood Accents To The Deck
Sometimes small changes are enough to transform any space completely. Especially if you use a versatile material such as wood , which goes with everything.
Suppose the deck in your backyard is already built with another material besides hardwood. Don't worry. You can still use Ipe to make it even more impressive and elegant.

Build a mini island around the pool area to place beach chairs for tanning. Also, use Ipe as cladding or on the ceiling. These elements combine perfectly with concrete, glass, or porcelain structures.
7. More Traditional Elements For Your Deck

If you are more conservative and don't want to make a big change in your backyard, you can start with traditional elements. Ipe wood is a strong material that will last for decades. How about using Ipe to build some long-lasting pieces of furniture, such as tables, chairs, or little walkways, perhaps made with Ipe shorts.
8. Use Ipe Deck Tiles In Your Backyard

If you are looking for a quick and easy installation system to improve some areas of your backyard, using deck tiles is a good way to go. As simple as putting a puzzle together, you have a completely renovated area in a short time.

Deck tiles are a consumer-friendly option that comes in a convenient interlocking format. Here at Brazilian Lumber, we have pre-assembled tiles made of attractive and durable Brazilian hardwood, mainly Ipe.

Our Ipe tiles are available with a smooth finish or anti-slip surface, well suited for applications near swimming pools or outdoor showers. You will be able to create stunning pathways that will enhance your backyard in a creative, useful, and quick way.

There you have it. With these recommendations, you are ready to do a fabulous makeover in your backyard to enjoy summer. Choose Ipe wood in any of its formats and go nuts with its workability, versatility, and extraordinary natural properties that make it the best material in the world.

posts.h1: The Best 5-Step Guide To Build A Deck Railing

blocks.text: The safer, the better. This is a very important statement for us, especially when building a deck. If you want to enjoy the sunset, the breeze, and nature from the comfort of your backyard without the risk of falling, putting up a deck railing is the smartest thing to do, especially if there are children or pets around.

There is a variety of options for deck railing and which one is best will depend on the design, the location, and the budget. The Brazilian Lumber team is happy to help each client find the appropriate material for his or her project.

You can use hardwoods to build a railing for your deck, which will look good if you are looking for a uniform appearance. Even then, you could use hardwood posts with wire railing. But keep in mind that hardwoods are just one option. You can also make a good deck railing with other materials.

Our team had prepared the ultimate 5-step guide to install a railing on your hardwood deck. There may be some steps that are a little more tricky, but we hope that you will achieve the desired result with our assistance. If you have some basic carpentry skills, you'll get it done!

Before getting started, be sure to check local codes to apply for all necessary permits. It is also important that you wear protective eye gear, work gloves, and sturdy footwear to avoid any injuries. Now you are ready to begin the process of DIY deck railing installation.
1. Know Your State's Regulations Before Installing A Deck Railing

Getting familiar with local deck construction regulations is important before installing a deck railing . Even though each state has its own rules, most states set a minimum deck railing height of 36 inches from the surface to the top railing of the deck on a regular basis.
Other states may require a deck railing height of 42 inches which may increase to 48 inches depending on specific conditions.
2. Preparing And Installing Deck Railing Posts
The first thing you need to determine is the number of posts you will need, depending on the design you want to achieve.
With the help of a tape measure, you can find out the distance from each straight outside edge of your deck. This will help you know how many 4X4 posts you need and how far apart each one should be.

We suggest putting a post at each corner and placing an extra support every 4-6 feet, depending on the size of the deck. Do not forget to mark the center of each post on the hardwood decking, so you know the exact spot where they go to make the installation later.

Next, measure the height of the posts, taking into account local regulations. The top rail should be at least 36 inches high. Add 4 inches to that measurement to attach each post to the deck with the appropriate fasteners. You may need to add an inch for the post cap at the top of the railing. Now you are ready to cut all the posts.

Then screw the posts to your deck where you have previously marked. Align the mark with the center of the post. Drill pilot holes before screwing to make the bolting process easier. Use a drill to make pilot holes through the overhang of the posts into the deck joists.
Attach the bottom railing between the deck posts with a deck railing connector. Use two spare pieces of lumber to support the bottom railing to your desired height while attaching it.

Some articles suggest applying a sealant to the posts before final installation, but this will not be necessary if you are using one of our premium hardwoods. Visit our website and take a look at our products and promotions. Our best-selling products are Ipe , Cumaru , Garapa , Jatoba , and Tigerwood .
These exotic hardwoods have amazing natural properties and extraordinary features that make them the best decking material . All of them have a long life span and are low maintenance.
3. Get Balusters And Wood For The Deck Railing

The next step is to build a handrail. For this part of the installation process, you will need some pre-cut pieces of wood, or you can also cut them yourself to size. Cut 1x3 or 2x4 lumber in lengths equal to the distance between the posts on your deck. You will need two pieces for each railing length to place, one at the bottom and one at the top.

Then, get plenty of 2x2 balusters to use for the railing. We suggest you place each of them at a maximum distance of 4 inches (10 cm). Keep in mind that the length of the balusters should be the height you want the railing to be.

You will also need wood strips. These thin strips should measure about 0.25 inches (0.64 cm) by 1.5 inches (3.8 cm). Cut them to exact dimensions, considering the distance between the deck posts. One strip will be required per section.
4. Assembling The Deck Railing Balusters

We are getting to the end of the installation process. Now it is time to attach the balusters near the ends of the wooden strips. Most local regulations establish that the balusters should be no more than 4 inches apart.

To attach the balusters, you can drive screws that are 1.5 inches (3.8 cm) to 2 inches (5.1 cm) through the strip and into their ends. For example, you can spread the balusters every 3 inches along the strip and then screw them in.

Sometimes it can be complicated to make the measurements to position the balusters correctly. Still, you can always use an online deck railing calculator to do the hard work. Another option is to call our team of professionals, who will be pleased to give you the support you need for your projects.

Once you have the top of the balusters attached to one of the strips, place another along its bottom. Drive screws that are 1.5 inches (3.8 cm) to 2 inches (5.1 cm) long into the balusters. This will make the structure more secure and the joints stronger.
5. Installing The Deck Railing
This is the last step to finally having a safe deck. Secure the bottom railing to the posts using a few pieces of wood to hold the base of the railing floor to your desired height.
Then drill angled holes through its bottom, toward the posts. Next, drive long screws through these holes and into the posts to hold the bottom railing securely. You can use 3- to 4-inch screws.

Now it's time to attach the balusters to the bottom rail. Use the thin strip to connect them to the center of the bottom rail. Next, drive a few screws into the strip in the bottom rail. Then attach the top rail, and drive more screws from the bottom, through the thin strip, and into the bottom of the top rail. Now all the pieces are securely fastened.

Repeat this procedure if your hardwood deck has more railing sections between other posts. Measure the distance between the posts, build the baluster assemblies, and attach them to the top and bottom railings.

In conclusion, it is always important to consider the safety factor when building something. Do a DIY deck railing installation on your hardwood deck and enjoy summer without worrying about falls. Follow these steps, inform about local deck construction regulations, and take a chance to try your first project. We will be here if you need any help.

posts.title: The 7 Most Important Reasons To Own A Pergola
posts.h1: The 7 Most Important Reasons To Own A Pergola

blocks.text: If you want to give a more visual appeal to your backyard, adding a pergola is the way to go. This structure will help you transform ordinary spaces into extraordinary places right away.

Having a pergola in the backyard means getting a personal spot where you can enjoy multiple activities while being in contact with nature. In addition to the sophistication and style it brings to the decoration of the outdoor area, it is a versatile and useful structure.

A pergola can become a space to have tea, play cards, relax or exercise. All this in an open area, surrounded by greenery. So, if you are looking for a personal oasis in the comfort of your backyard, there is no better idea than to build this structure.

There are many materials from which you can build it, but if you are looking for durability, hardwoods are the best choice. Hardwoods have a lot of natural properties that provide them exceptional features, such as resistance to water, rot, mildew, insect pests, and weathering. Plus, they have a long life span and are low maintenance.

Our recommendation here at Brazilian Lumber is to choose any from our premium hardwoods. Make your structure out of Ipe , Cumaru , Garapa , Jatoba , or Tigerwood , and enjoy a beautiful and strong material for an endless time. Take advantage of their stunning color variations and impressive characteristics and build an authentic piece of art.

But wait, there is more. Hardwoods are a very versatile material. So, if you go for one made of hardwood, you will get a functional structure that can have different styles and shapes depending on your needs.

Adding hanging plants or installing lights or panels on top of the wood provides more shade. Feel free to try whatever you have in mind to build your personalized pergola design to enjoy gathering with friends at sunset.
There are many reasons you should have this amazing structure in the backyard, but since we like to make your life easier, here is a list of the 7 most important ones.
1. A Pergola Creates An Extension To The Outdoor Area

Having a place to be in contact with nature will improve your quality of life. Suppose you already have a backyard and want to make the outdoor area more attractive and eye-catching. In that case, a pergola is all you need.

When we say that this structure creates an extension of the outdoor area, we mean that it will provide a private yet open-air spot in the middle of the exterior space. This will give you the feeling of having two environments in the same place.
They are a versatile structure found mostly in modern open-style homes that allow for an easy transition from indoors to outdoors. Still, you can also find them in a more traditional backyard.
You can install sliding doors to the backyard and connect the living room to the patio and the structure. It will look like you have a large social area to enjoy with family and friends.

Keep in mind that you can style it any way you like or need. For example, you can build a roof to protect yourself from inclement weather. Likewise, you can put lights around the pergola to enjoy the place at night. You can do almost anything you want with this fantastic structure.
2. A Pergola Is An Ideal Place For Entertaining

When people think of building a pergola, the first purpose that comes to mind is to have a new space for entertaining. A pergola is that perfect place where you can do all the activities you enjoy the most.

You can personalize its design according to your needs. It can be the perfect place to have an afternoon coffee while gossiping, meet with friends, host a party, have a barbecue, play cards with family, or take morning yoga classes.
3. Create A Superb Garden By Adding A Pergola
If you plan to spend a lot of time in your new structure, make it the coziest place in your home. Putting some flowers around it can bring warmth and a pleasant aroma to the area.

If this idea persuades you, you can take it to the next level and adapt the roots on the posts so that the plant grows vertically. Or, if you are looking for a more traditional and romantic style, you can place hanging plants.
There are some species with which you can create a beautiful natural ceiling by intertwining them on the boards, such as clematis, ivy, grape vines, and others.
4. A Pergola Protects From The Elements

Typically, backyards are open-air spaces without roofs. This is fine in the summer, but what can you do if you host a party, and it starts to rain? Luckily, adding a structure is the solution for that.

Most of them are built with a semi-open roof made of boards of the same wood as their base and side posts. Others have a natural roof made of climbing flowers. These roofs will protect you from sunny or windy days, but not really from the rain. You can go for a mobile shelter on a rainy day, like a canopy that you can open and close when needed.
5. You Can Combine A Pergola With Other Structures

One of the best things about a wooden structure is that you can combine it with structures of different materials. It is a versatile construction that goes perfectly with wood, concrete, or stone decks. You can even install an artificial turf area with any of the varieties we offer at Royal Turf .
6. A Pergola Can Be A Poolside Lounge

Use your creativity to create a delightful outdoor oasis near the water by adding a pergola to the pool area. It will always be more pleasant to drink some cocktails, take advantage of the sun, and relax in the comfort of of this structure.
You can give it a romantic design with some flowers and warm lights if you have an outdoor hot tub.
7. A Pergola Increases The Value Of A Property

Wood pergolas add a structure that maximizes the outdoor space, adding more potential to the backyard. For example, having a pergola will give additional advantages over properties that don't have one. Why? Because a pergola provides extra space in the exterior area that can be enjoyed in multiple ways.

To sum up, building a pergola will provide you with a special place for entertaining, relaxing, enjoying the weather, and gathering with friends and family. It will also enhance your backyard with a structure that will be very useful as well as aesthetically pleasing.

We recommend a hardwood pergola so that you can be sure of the quality, strength, and durability of your new construction. We suggest you choose any of our premium species such as Ipe , Cumaru , Garapa , or Jatoba . All of them will give you the results you were expecting.
And last but not least, give your pergola your own style. Add some hanging flowers, place warm lights around it, and make a unique outdoor living space that meets your needs.

posts.title: 8 Most Stunning Summer Setups With Composite Decking
posts.h1: 8 Most Stunning Summer Setups With Composite Decking

blocks.text: If you're looking to get your backyard in shape for summer and want a material that is just as durable as hardwood, composite decking is all you need. This amazing material is an incredible alternative for creating the finest setups for the hot days ahead.

Another good aspect to consider when upgrading your backyard is that building an outdoor area can give you the best of different styles. You can create a luxurious place to gather with friends, or you can go for a more free and simple style where you can enjoy nature. A composite deck for the backyard allows you to experience the best of both environments.
Composite decking is the fastest-growing alternative to wood decking on the market. Its major advantage is that it has a core and cover that makes it resistant to moisture, weathering, and fading.

This material, invented around the 1980s, consists of wood fibers coated with plastic. The plastic and wood used are often made from recycled materials, making composite decking an environmentally friendly option.
Although there is a fear that composite decking may not be as nice and organic-looking as natural wood, thanks to modern technology, that is no longer an issue.

Composite decking has many similarities with hardwood decking. Both composite and hardwood decking are materials with high quality, low maintenance, and resistance to external factors. The bonus with composite decking is that it is a cost-efficient choice.
