posts.title: The Latest Trends in Wood Flooring in 2023 That Will Add Home Value To Your Home
posts.h1: The Latest Trends in Wood Flooring in 2023 That Will Add Home Value To Your Home

blocks.text: Wood flooring has been a popular choice for many homeowners for centuries. Not only is it aesthetically pleasing, but it also adds value to your home. With so many available options, choosing the right one for your home can be overwhelming.
In this blog post, we will discuss the latest trends in wood flooring and how to choose the right option for your home.
Latest Trends in Wood Flooring

Whether renovating your current home or flipping a rental property, flooring is vital to increasing your home value . To help you start the process, we've made a helpful guide on some of the most popular wood flooring trends this year.
Here are the Top 12 Wood Flooring Trends in 2023 that will add home value to your home:

items: Rustic Flooring.

blocks.text: Current flooring trends go beyond just color and include different textures, such as rustic flooring , which has a unique appeal. The rough and natural texture of rustic flooring can create a calming effect on the viewer, as it reminds them of nature and its surfaces.
There are several ways to style rustic floorings, such as hand-scraping or wire-brushing to enhance its texture or using reclaimed materials to give it a unique look.
Using rustic textures can add depth to any room. It is particularly suitable for homes with a natural appearance and vibe, like cottages, farmhouses, and lodges.

items: Natural & Neutral Colors.

blocks.text: The minimalist design movement is gaining more popularity , including flooring choices. Instead of bold or busy flooring patterns, homeowners opt for natural and neutral colors that can blend with different areas of the house , like dining rooms and bedrooms. Versatile shades like white, cream, and honey are in demand . They are suitable for homes, luxury condos, and commercial spaces. These shades create a peaceful surrounding that can be customized according to personal preferences.
Natural-looking floors create the perfect backdrop for any room and help balance your space.

items: Wider and Longer Plank Flooring.

blocks.text: Wide plank flooring has become increasingly popular in recent years. Planks measuring 5-12 inches in width create a more spacious feel in any room. The wider planks also allow more of the wood's natural features, such as knots and grain patterns, to be displayed.
Wide plank floors perfectly fit any vibe , from smooth and contemporary, to rustic or reclaimed. No matter your style, they will make a big impression on your new floor.

items: Lighter Colors.

blocks.text: Another popular trend in wood flooring is lighter colors. Lighter wood floors can make your space feel more open and airy . Popular lighter wood options include white oak, maple, and ash.

items: Engineered Wood.

blocks.text: Engineered wood is becoming an increasingly popular choice for homeowners. Engineered wood is more durable and moisture-resistant than solid wood , making it an excellent option for moisture-prone areas. Not all homeowners put in new hardwood, however.

Thanks to a surging interest in sustainable, environmentally friendly practices, Ferguson says many homeowners are going with reclaimed wood flooring salvaged from elsewhere and refitted for the new floor.
"People are focusing on recycling more and making the most of the materials that are already there, ready to be used," he says.

Another plus: Depending on the vintage, homeowners can score higher-quality old-growth wood unavailable on the regular market. Why? Be cause regulations have changed, cutting down these source trees is no longer allowed.

items: Gray and White Washed Wood.

blocks.text: Gray and white-washed wood flooring is a popular trend that provides a modern and contemporary look . The flooring is achieved by applying a wash of gray or white stain to the surface, giving it a more subdued appearance while maintaining the natural beauty of the wood.
While light wood tones help to brighten a space, gray and white-washed wood tones create a relaxed and rustic atmosphere in a home.

items: Chevron and Herringbone Patterns.

blocks.text: Chevron and herringbone patterns have become increasingly popular in recent years, providing a stylish and unique look to any room. These patterns are achieved by laying the planks at an angle, creating a V or zig-zag shape . They can create a focal point in a room or add visual interest to an otherwise bland space.

items: Mixed Width Planks.

blocks.text: Using planks of varying widths creates a more dynamic look and can also be used to create a pattern or design on the floor.

items: Dark and High-Contrast Wood.

blocks.text: Dark and high-contrast wood flooring has become popular recently, offering a bold and dramatic look . This flooring contrasts sharply with lighter walls and furniture, creating a striking effect.

" Mid- to dark-brown wood floors are starting to have a moment, " says Marc Bacher, founder of Scandinavian hardwood floor company Stuga . While light-colored floors make a space feel bigger and more open, darker brown flooring is perfect for creating a cozier style in your rooms.

items: Matte Finishes.

blocks.text: Matte finishes offer a more natural look and feel to the wood. Unlike traditional gloss finishes, matte finishes are less reflective, making them ideal for rooms with natural light or high foot traffic.
Plus: they have the added advantage of hiding dust and imperfections better.
How to Choose the Right Option for Your Home
When choosing the right wood flooring, there are several factors to consider. Here are a few tips to help you make the right decision:

When choosing wood flooring, it is essential to consider your lifestyle. If you have pets or children, select a more durable and scratch-resistant wood , such as oak or hickory. On the other hand, if you live in a quieter household, you may choose a softer wood , such as cherry or walnut.
Think about the room's function.

The function of the room should also be taken into consideration. For example, a high-traffic area like a living room or kitchen may require a more durable and water-resistant wood , such as bamboo or engineered wood. On the other hand, a bedroom may benefit from a softer wood that creates a warmer and more comfortable atmosphere.
Choose the right color and finish.

Light wood, such as maple or ash, can help create a brighter, more open space. In contrast, darker wood, such as walnut or mahogany, can add a sense of sophistication and luxury to the room. The finish of the wood should also be considered, with gloss and matte being the two most popular options.
Consider the installation process.

The installation process is an essential factor to consider when choosing wood flooring. Solid wood flooring requires a subfloor and can be more challenging to install, while engineered wood can be installed over existing floors and might be more cost-effective.
Conclusion

Wood flooring is a timeless and versatile option for any home. From sustainable options to herringbone patterns, there are many different trends. When selecting the right choice for your home, consider your style, location, budget, and maintenance requirements.

posts.title: Outdoor Furniture Maintenance: How to Keep Your Garden Amazing All Year
posts.h1: Outdoor Furniture Maintenance: How to Keep Your Garden Amazing All Year

blocks.text: There's nothing like spending time in your garden, enjoying the sun, entertaining guests, or simply relaxing with a good book. However, to keep your outdoor furniture looking its best all year round, you must take good care of it . In this blog post, we'll give tips for outdoor furniture maintenance and keeping your garden looking fabulous.
Outdoor Furniture Maintenance: Know Your Outdoor Furniture Materials

Outdoor furniture can be wood, metal, plastic, or wicker. Each material requires different cleaning and care methods . For example, wood furniture may require a protective coating to withstand the elements. Metal furniture may need to be treated for rust.
According to your wood type, these general outdoor furniture maintenance tips will ensure that your chairs, tables, and cushions look beautiful for years.

items: Wicker Furniture

blocks.text: Regular cleaning is recommended for wicker, as it generally cannot endure harsh or abrasive treatments. This also minimizes mildew buildup. Sand lightly with fine-grit sandpaper to remove any peeling paint, and touch up with paint as necessary.

items: Wood Furniture

blocks.text: Seal the wood to protect it from ultraviolet rays, dirt, and moisture or preserve restored color. First, clean surfaces and sand off any existing finishes. Touch up with paint if needed. Apply a clear water-repellent preservative that contains a mildewcide or a penetrating semi-transparent stain.

items: Metal Furniture
If the furniture manufacturer recommends, apply a coat of quality liquid or paste auto wax with a lint-free cloth.
Use silicone spray to lubricate swivels and glides on chairs, ribs, and poles on umbrellas.
Inspect for rust or chips regularly, especially in hidden areas where the surface may be unfinished (even stainless steel can rust in salty environments).
Fabric-Covered Furniture

blocks.text: Regularly brush off dirt and debris, and rinse as needed. Wipe spills and stains immediately with a wet cloth and a mild soap solution because certain liquids, such as sunscreen, may cause discoloration. Some fabrics have a water-repellent finish (check care guide) that loses effectiveness over time. To restore repellence, clean and dry the material and apply a fabric protector. Let dry between coats. Repeat once a year or whenever water stops beading on the surface.

items: Plastic Furniture

blocks.text: Sunscreen residue can discolor some plastics, so wipe the furniture with a wet cloth and a mild soap solution soon after exposure.
Outdoor Furniture Maintenance: 10 Tips

One of the easiest ways to keep outdoor furniture in good condition is to clean it regularly. Dust, pollen, and other debris can accumulate on your furniture, which can cause it to deteriorate faster. To clean your furniture, simply use a soft-bristled brush or a damp cloth to wipe it down.
Keeping your outdoor furniture clean is one of the best ways to ensure it lasts long.
Here's what you should do:

items: Remove pillows before cleaning.
Mix a solution of 1/4 cup mild liquid soap & 1-gallon water.
Use a sponge or soft scrub brush to clean the surface, moving toward the wood grain.
If stains stay, use fine-grit sandpaper to clear them.
Flush totally with cold water.
Air-dry completely before replacing cushions or protecting them with a cover.

blocks.text: Tip 2: Use Protective Covers

If you have expensive outdoor furniture, it's worth investing in protective covers. Covers will protect your furniture from the elements, including rain, snow, and intense sunlight. Covers are also helpful if you're away for an extended period and want to protect your furniture from the elements.
Tip 3: Store Your Furniture in the Winter

If you live in an area that experiences harsh winters, storing outdoor furniture inside during the colder months is a good idea for outdoor furniture maintenance. This will protect it from the elements and extend its lifespan. If you don't have space to keep your furniture indoors, consider investing in weather-resistant covers.
However, winter should not impede enjoying the outdoors. In this blog, we show you ideas on how to enjoy your garden during the colder months .
Tip 4: Use a Protective Coating

If your outdoor furniture is made of wood, it's a good idea to use a protective coating to keep it in good condition. Coatings such as varnish, oils , or sealant can protect your furniture from moisture, insects, and sunlight . Be sure to choose a coating suitable for outdoor use and follow the manufacturer's instructions for application.
Tip 5: Keep Your Furniture Dry
Water can be one of the most damaging elements to outdoor furniture. To keep your furniture in good condition, ensure it's kept dry. If it gets wet, use a towel to dry it off as soon as possible.
Tip 6: Avoid Harsh Chemicals

While you may be tempted to use harsh chemicals to clean your outdoor furniture, they can do more harm than good. Chemicals can damage the finish of your furniture and cause it to deteriorate faster. Instead, use mild soap and water to clean your furniture.
Tip 7: Protect Your Furniture from the Sun

Strong sunlight can cause your outdoor furniture to fade and crack. Consider using a protective cover or moving it to a shaded area to protect your furniture from the sun. You can also use an umbrella or shade sail to provide extra protection.
Tip 8: Remove Stains Quickly

If you spill food or drinks on your outdoor furniture, removing the stain as quickly as possible is essential . Use a mild soap and water to clean the stain, and rinse it with clean water. You may need to use a specialized cleaner if the stain is stubborn.
Tip 9: Check for Damage Regularly

Regularly check your outdoor furniture for damage, such as cracks, splinters, or rust. Catching damage early can prevent it from worsening and prolong your furniture's life. If you notice any damage, repair it as soon as possible.
Tip 10: Invest in High-Quality Materials

Finally, investing in high-quality materials is one of the best ways to ensure your outdoor furniture lasts for years. At Brazilian Lumber , we provide some of the best wood for outdoor furniture and decks. Our hardwoods are ideal for outdoor use , naturally resisting moisture and insects.
Outdoor Furniture Maintenance: Mastering the Art of a Picture-Perfect Garden

Maintaining your outdoor furniture is essential to keep your garden looking fantastic all year round . Following these tips can protect your investment and ensure your furniture lasts for years. From regular cleaning to investing in high-quality materials, you can keep your outdoor furniture looking great in many ways.

At Brazilian Lumber , we're proud to offer a wide selection of high-quality hardwoods for your outdoor furniture and decking needs. Our hardwoods are naturally resistant to moisture and insects , making them an ideal choice for outdoor use. We also provide excellent customer service and are always happy to help you find the right wood for your project.

posts.h1: Wall Panel Design: The Ultimate Trend For a Stylish and Modern Home

blocks.text: Regarding home decor, the walls are essential in creating a stylish and modern ambiance. Wall panels are a popular choice among homeowners, as they add texture, depth, and character to any room.
Not only do they look great, but they also offer several benefits that make them a practical addition to your home.
In this blog, we will explore the benefits and uses of wall panels and share ideas to incorporate them into your home. Keep reading!
What are Wall Panels?

Wall panels are a type of decorative covering used to shield the walls of a room. They come in various materials, including wood, metal, and plastic. Wood wall panels are particularly popular because they add warmth and texture to a room and are easy to install.

Interior designer Jenna Choate, Co-Founder at Interior Fox , says: " Panelling is an easy way to add texture, depth, and interest to walls and great for all types of properties, especially where architectural features are minimal."

"When working with a small space, vertical paneling is a great technique for making walls appear taller as it draws the eye upwards." Then, she adds: " In large spaces, full-height paneling prevents the room from looking sparse and one-dimensional and can help zone an open-plan space that has multifunctional uses. "
Benefits of Wall Panels

Wall panels are durable and long-lasting. They are made from high-quality materials and designed to withstand daily use's wear and tear. Unlike paint or wallpaper, wall panels resist scratches, dents, and stains . This makes them an excellent choice for high-traffic areas such as the living room, kitchen, or hallway.

Wall panels are easy to clean and maintain . They require little upkeep and must not be repainted or replaced frequently. You only need a damp cloth and mild detergent to keep them looking their best.

The installation part of home improvement projects is often the main reason people delay such endeavors. Home redesigns can be laborious, prolonged, and expensive, especially if you hire professionals.

However, wall paneling is a different story . It is a great DIY project that is easy to install , making it an excellent option for those who are handy or eager to learn. The tongue-and-groove designs and clipping systems make wall panel installation easier than putting together some children's toys.
You only need the correct dimensions, supplies, suitable tools, and some free time to install them.
4. Different Material Choices:

While traditional wall paneling is wooden, there are other options than this material ! Modern materials such as medium-density fiberboard and melamine are also durable and impact-resistant, making them suitable for high-traffic areas where scuffing and denting are likely to occur.
5. Wall Paneling Offers Protection for Your Walls:
Paneling is more than just decorative. It also serves a practical purpose by covering your walls from damage !

Additionally, impact-resistant paneling is available for increased protection against accidental impacts. If your wall paneling shows signs of damage, replacing or cleaning a section of the paneling is easier than repairing drywall.
6. Design Choices For All:
There are multiple ways to cover your walls with paneling . In the past, the type of wall paneling in residential and commercial buildings has adjusted to reflect society's tastes and trends.
Today, paneling is more budget-friendly for people of all incomes. You can choose the wall paneling design that suits your style, personality, and budget .
7. Use As Camouflage for Unaesthetic Features:

We can all have a slight dent or imperfection in the walls of the house that are annoying to the eye. Wall paneling is an ingenious and beautiful way to cover those flaws and add a decorative touch to your spaces.

But not only that. Wall panels can also be used to hide unaesthetic objects, such as cables, or to camouflage disused structures or bigger elements that are difficult to remove, such as an old fireplace.
8. Soundproofing and Insulation Function:

If you are looking for a simple way to add more soundproofing and insulation to your home, wall paneling can also help. Adding this layer to your walls can help keep warm air in during the winter and cool air in during the summer. It also acts as an additional buffer to sounds from outside your home or between rooms so that you can enjoy a quieter environment.
Uses of Wall Panels

The living room is one of the most common areas of the home where wall panels are used. They add texture and depth to the space and create a warm and inviting ambiance. Wood panels can be used to create a rustic or country-style decor, while metal panels can add a modern touch to the room. Also, wall panels in the living room can be practical for framing pictures while creating a beautiful visual style.

Wall panels are also an excellent choice for the bedroom. You can use them to create a focal point behind the bed, creating more saving spaces, or add texture and depth to the room. Wood panels also create a cozy and romantic ambiance, while metal panels can add a touch of elegance and sophistication.

The kitchen can use wall panels to create a functional and decorative backsplash. They can be made from various materials, including wood, metal, and plastic. Wood panels can create a rustic or country-style kitchen, while metal panels can add a modern touch to the space.
Ideas on How to Add Wall Panels to Your Home

items: Painted Panels for a Pop of Color

blocks.text: The touch of color your home needs! They come in various colors and can be used to create a focal point or add a splash of color to a room. Painted panels are the perfect way to add personality and style to your home.

blocks.text: You can choose modern wood panels with clean lines and minimalistic designs for a sleek and modern look. These are excellent options for creating a contemporary and stylish home ambiance.

items: Mixed Materials for a Creative Look

You can mix wood panels with metal panels or stone with concrete panels to create a unique and distinctive look. Mixed material panels are an excellent choice for homeowners who want to create a one-of-a-kind home decor that reflects their personality and style.

posts.title: The 4 Most Important Facts Why Replanting Trees Isn't Always Good For The Planet
posts.h1: The 4 Most Important Facts Why Replanting Trees Isn't Always Good For The Planet

blocks.text: Replanting trees has become a popular way to fight deforestation and climate change. However, potential drawbacks and unintended consequences must be considered. Replanting trees may seem like an obvious solution, but it is not always the best alternative. Important facts stand on why replanting trees isn't always good for the planet.

items: Planting non-native trees.
Impact on local communities.
Monoculture.
Carbon sequestration impact.
Consider what is underground

blocks.text: It's important to note that some environments where we don't see trees still have a lot of biodiversity below the surface. Planting trees in such areas (like prairies and marshlands) can be very damaging to the environment.
One crucial factor to consider when replanting trees is the type of trees being planted. While planting new trees can be a good idea, choosing the proper species for each environment is essential.

According to a United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization report, planting non-native tree species can have negative consequences, including altered ecosystems and decreased biodiversity. This is why it's important to plant native trees well-suited to the local environment, as they are more likely to thrive and support the surrounding ecosystem.

Another crucial factor to consider when replanting trees is the impact on local communities. While reforestation can have many positive benefits, involving local communities and respecting their needs and rights is important.

As a report by the Forest Peoples Program highlights, "many reforestation projects have been imposed on communities, without their free, prior, and informed consent, or adequate recognition and protection of their land rights." This can lead to conflicts and unintended negative consequences, including displacement and loss of livelihoods.
In addition to these factors, there are other important considerations when replanting them. One key issue is the potential for monoculture: planting a single species over a large area.

While this may seem like an efficient approach, it can have negative consequences, such as decreased biodiversity and resilience to environmental change. It's important to prioritize a diverse mix of tree species when replanting to have a healthy and resilient ecosystem.

Another important consideration is the impact of replanting trees on carbon sequestration . While planting them is often seen as a way to absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and combat climate change, the effectiveness of this approach can vary depending on several factors.

As a report by the Center for International Forestry Research notes, "planting them in previously not forested areas can affect carbon sequestration absorption, as these trees will take decades to mature and fully sequester significant amounts of carbon".

So, while replanting them is an important strategy to combat deforestation and climate change, it's essential to consider the specific circumstances and potential consequences. Planting native species, involving local communities, and prioritizing diversity, are all essential factors to consider for replanting trees effectively and sustainably. As well as adopting a long-term approach to avoid affecting carbon sequestration.

This doesn't mean we should stop replanting trees altogether. Instead, it's vital to approach reforestation thoughtfully and strategically. As individuals, we can also play a role by supporting reforestation efforts and making conscious choices in our daily lives to reduce our impact on the environment. Together, we can protect our planet for future generations.
What Can You Do Besides Replanting Trees?

items: Reduce paper consumption: One of the biggest drivers of deforestation is the demand for paper products. This can be done by printing less, using electronic documents, and recycling paper.
Choose sustainable products: Always prefer products that are sustainably produced and - in the case of the wood industry - sourced.
Be well-informed and do your due diligence before donating to a reforestation program.
Advocate for policy change: Governments have a crucial role in combating deforestation, and individuals can advocate for policies that protect forests and reduce this environmental issue.

blocks.text: To sum up, replanting them without the proper knowledge to do it right can be more harmful than good for the planet. There are some ways of protecting the Earth and its biodiversity. Get information, learn more about the topic, and contribute to environmental conservation. The Earth needs you!

posts.title: 3 Main Reasons Why Older Trees Are The Best Ones To Remove
posts.h1: 3 Main Reasons Why Older Trees Are The Best Ones To Remove

blocks.text: Trees are an essential part of our environment. They provide numerous benefits, such as improving air quality, reducing noise pollution, and creating habitats for wildlife. However, sometimes they need to be removed due to different reasons. In this blog, we will explore the main reasons why older trees are the best ones to cut down.

According to the American Hardwood Information Center, the older ones are often harvested for lumber, which can be used to make a variety of products that improve our daily lives. From furniture to decking, American hardwoods are a sustainable and versatile material that can be found in homes, offices, and public spaces across the country.
Why Older Trees Are The Best Ones To Remove: Reason # 1

As they age, their structural integrity decreases, making them more vulnerable to storm damage, pest infestations, and disease. This can lead to branches falling and the entire tree toppling over, which can cause property damage and even injury to people.

In addition, the older ones can also have a negative impact on infrastructure such as sidewalks, roads, and buildings. As they age, their root system grows, causing severe damage, such as lifting concrete sidewalks and damaging subway pipes. Removing older trees can prevent costly infrastructure repairs and improve public safety.
Why Older Trees Are The Best Ones To Remove: Reason # 2

Another reason why the older ones are the best to remove is that they can block sunlight from reaching other plants in the area. As trees grow older and taller, they can cast a large shadow, preventing sunlight from reaching other plants, including grass, shrubs, and other trees. This can lead to stunted growth or even the death of other plants.

Removing them can also create space for new growth and biodiversity. They can become overcrowded and prevent the development of surrounding species. Removing these species can create space for new trees and plants to grow, creating a healthier ecosystem.
At Brazilian Lumber , we follow an interesting procedure for our logging activity, which agrees precisely with the recommendation to choose old trees. This is our process:

items: A register of flora and fauna is kept, and each tree species is identified.
Only 3 to 4 trees are selected per hectare.
The selection is made on mature trees that have completed their life cycle.
We have a 100% chain of custody over our trees.

blocks.text: Why Older Trees Are The Best Ones To Remove: Reason # 3
The older ones are more susceptible to pest infestations and diseases, which can spread to others in the area. Removing them helps to preserve the overall health of the ecosystem.

According to Frank Lloyd Wright's TED conference speech, trees play a crucial role in creating sustainable environments and improving the quality of life for people. He emphasized that planting trees is a long-term investment that benefits future generations. "Plant trees. They give us two of the most crucial elements for our survival: oxygen and books.", Wright said. He also emphasized the importance of preserving old-growth forests, as they provide habitat for countless species and protect biodiversity.

It's important to emphasize that once a tree is removed, space is left for natural regeneration, which also contributes to the protection of biodiversity. In addition, dying trees release carbon, the opposite of what we need for our atmosphere. That is why in the timber industry, the candidates for logging are mature that have completed their useful life cycle.

Besides this statement, if we relate the removal of the older ones to the wood industry, we get an extra benefit associated with well-being. Multiple researchers have recently discovered that a proper environment provides physical and psychological benefits.

This is called Biophilic Design . This concept is based on the idea that environmental structures significantly impact human well-being. Therefore, learning about the wonders of being surrounded by lumber is very useful.

A study from the University of British Columbia indicates that having wooden elements and plants as part of the office or home environment provides stress-reducing effects. Research also shows that lumber improves attention & cognitive function, increases creativity, and reduces pain perception.

In addition, wooden structures or accents can prevent mental or physical deterioration in older adults. Some investigations from different universities establish that the physical environment impacts patient stress, staff efficiency, and quality of care in healthcare facilities. The material a room is made of, the decorative elements, and even the colors impact a patient's recovery process.

An excellent example of this theory is explained in a study by Roger Ulrich comparing the recovery of some patients after surgery. They all had the same surgery, but some were sent to a room with a brick view, while others were sent to a room with large windows from which they could see trees and nature. Of course, the second group recovered faster.

To conclude, they play a crucial role in our lives, providing numerous benefits to the environment and the people around them. It is our responsibility to take care of them and preserve them as much as possible.

However, when removing them is necessary, it is important to consider the tree's age and its impact on the environment. Older trees are often the best to remove, as they are more decay-resistant. They can also block sunlight, cause damage to infrastructure, and become a breeding ground for pests and diseases.
So, before cutting down a tree, learn how to do it properly without compromising biodiversity.

posts.title: Brazilian Lumber Does A Great Job Protecting The Earth
posts.h1: Brazilian Lumber Does A Great Job Protecting The Earth

blocks.text: T he Earth needs to be protected, and Brazilian Lumber is doing its part to contribute to this cause. As a company that specializes in producing and selling lumber, we have taken on the challenge of following sustainable forestry management practices to minimize environmental impact .
Since tomorrow is Earth Day, we want to share with you how our process contributes to the preservation of the forests and the planet.

At Brazilian Lumber , we follow 4 steps in our forestry procedure. First, we keep a register of flora and fauna, identifying each species. Second, we select only 3 to 4 trees per hectare to be harvested. Third, the selection is made on mature trees that have completed their life cycle. And last but not least, we have a chain of custody for 100% of our trees, which helps certify that our process is sustainable.

Here is what Laura, one of Brazilian Lumber's owners, said about the topic during an interview. "We have to follow all the protocols and all the local laws on harvesting to do it right, respecting the cycle of the trees and the environment itself. If local harvesting laws weren't there, what other interest would go in? Farming and Mining, and what do farming and mining industries do? They cut down every tree, not even to sell that lumber; they just burn it, and then there is a lot of air and water pollution. So really, when you go in for milling trees is a very sustainable, responsible action that, by being done properly, does not harm the environment".

Protecting the Earth is one of our core values. As a company, we are committed to doing our part in taking care of the forests, biodiversity, and the planet. By following sustainable forestry management practices, we can ensure that the next generations will have enough resources.

That is exactly what sustainable forestry management means. A practice that involves managing forest resources to meet existing needs without compromising what future generations may need. It consists of a range of methods, including reforestation, selective cutting, and monitoring the health of the forest ecosystem.
For a better comprehension, let's go deeper into some of these practices:
This is how Brazilian Lumber Is Protecting The Earth

This involves carefully selecting trees to be harvested based on their size, maturity, and health. By selecting only the trees that have accomplished their life cycle, the company can ensure that the forest ecosystem is not disturbed more than necessary.

For proper harvesting, it is essential to use equipment and techniques that minimize the impact on the forest. For example, choosing chainsaws specially designed to make smaller cuts reduces the amount of waste generated during harvesting.

Once the lumber is harvested, it is transported to the processing facilities, where various wood products are manufactured. The company must control the process, ensuring that all waste generated is recycled or reused.
At Brazilian Lumber, we have a 100% chain of custody, so we know where our wood has been and how it has been treated for its production.
Finally, the lumber is sold to customers seeking high-quality, sustainable wood products. Brazilian Lumber is proud to offer lumber that is harvested and processed in an earth-friendly manner.

To sum up, a lumber industry can have sustainable forestry management by carefully selecting trees before logging to harvest only the mature ones. Then, for the harvesting phase, it is essential to use low-impact logging techniques and commit to recycling and reusing residues.
As a consumer, you can also do your part to help preserve the Earth by buying high-quality, sustainable lumber products. Brazilian Lumber offers FSC-certified wood (Forest Stewardship Council).
When you buy FSC-certified wood, you can be sure it has been harvested and processed in compliance with strict environmental, social, and economic standards.

By buying from Brazilian Lumber, you are guaranteed to get high-quality wood while contributing to the protection of the earth. You are just one click away from your "green" action of the day. Get sustainable lumber here !

blocks.text: Are you looking for a unique and eye-catching piece of art to add to your home decoration? Look no further than a Live Edge Slab! This natural piece of wood can bring a touch of rustic charm to any room due to its singular beauty and versatility.
What is a Live Edge Slab?

A Live Edge Slab is a piece of wood that retains the natural edge of the tree it was cut from. This edge is typically uneven and irregular, preserving the organic shape of the tree. The slab can be cut to any size or shape, making it a versatile piece that can be used in many ways.

Their natural beauty, stunning patterns, and versatility are some of their main characteristics. Slabs regularly contain wood imperfections such as stains, knots, and holes that add to the unique appearance of each piece. If treated skillfully, these defects are not a problem but contribute to overall beauty.

At Brazilian Lumber , each of our live edge slabs is hand selected and dried to ensure a perfectly natural product. All our slabs come from tropical hardwood trees, which increase their durability, quality, and resistance to external hazards.
Advantages Of A Live Edge Slab

items: Natural beauty
Versatility
Longevity
Unique patterns
Durability

blocks.text: No two live edge slabs are alike due to their unique patterns. Each piece has a different design and even tones, which increases their appeal. Right now, we have live edge slabs made from a wood called Parota or Guanacaste. We have all kinds of shapes, round pieces, long skinny pieces, and artistic pieces. In addition, these amazing slabs can be used for about anything:
Top 8 Uses For A Live Edge Slab:

items: Coffee tables
Side tables
Nightstands
Benches
Countertops
Bars
Doors
Pieces of art (on the walls or stands)

blocks.text: How to Sand a Live Edge Slab

If you have purchased a Live Edge Slab, you should sand it to achieve a polished finish. Here is a quick step-by-step guide on how to do it, or you can also click here to watch a video about the process:

items: We recommend using a vault hand sander to sand the wood piece.
Start with 40 grit. Then move on with 60, 80, 100, and 120 girt.
Once you have finished sanding, wipe the slab's surface with a damp cloth to remove any dust.
Apply wood oil to the slab's surface with a clean cloth. This will help to protect the wood and enhance its natural beauty.
Let the oil soak into the wood for the recommended time, usually between 15 and 30 minutes.
Wipe off any excess oil with a clean cloth.
Let the slab dry completely for at least 24 hours before using it.

blocks.text: In conclusion, a Live Edge Slab is a versatile and unique art piece that can add rustic charm to any home decoration. Its natural edge and striking patterns make it a standout piece that can be used in various ways, from coffee tables to wall art.

While it may require more maintenance than other types of furniture, its durability and longevity make it a worthwhile investment. So, if you're looking to add a touch of natural beauty to your home, having a Live Edge Slab is a must!

posts.title: Top 7 Reasons To Add A Railing To Your Deck
posts.h1: Top 7 Reasons To Add A Railing To Your Deck

blocks.text: When it comes to building a deck, safety is a top priority. No one wants to worry about accidents or injuries when enjoying outdoor space. That's why adding a railing to your deck is a must. Not only does it provide a safer place, but it can also enhance the overall aesthetic of your deck. Whether you have a hardwood or composite deck, a railing can be customized to match any style.

items: Baluster: It is a vertical element that is used to support the handrail or railing of a staircase or balcony. It typically consists of a small column or post, often ornately designed, that is placed at regular intervals along the length of the structure. Balusters provide both support and safety by preventing people from falling off the stairs or balcony.

Guardrail: It is a horizontal or vertical barrier that is installed along the edge of a balcony, staircase, or raised platform to prevent people from falling off. It can be made of various materials such as wood, metal, or glass, and is typically designed to withstand impact and resist lateral forces. Guardrails are often required by building codes and regulations for safety purposes.

blocks.text: The Brazilian Lumber team can help you add a railing to your deck, meeting your needs and style preferences. We have the experts and plenty of material options to build the right railing for safe entertaining. If you have doubts about adding a barrier to your deck, here are the top 7 reasons you should include this element in your construction project.ç
1. Add A Railing For Safety

A deck without a railing can become a hazard, especially if it's elevated or has multiple levels. Accidental falls can result in serious injuries. This element provides a physical barrier to prevent these types of accidents, making your deck a safer place to spend time with family and friends.

It is important that railings meet local building codes. These codes require that all decks higher than 30 inches above ground level have a barrier of at least 36 inches in height from the surface of the deck to the top of the rail.

Even if your deck is lower than 30 inches, installing a guardrail that meets code requirements is essential for safety. Building codes regulate certain deck features, such as rail height, baluster spacing, and guardrail strength, to ensure they are safe and compliant with local regulations.
2. Having A Railing Increases Property Value

A well-designed deck can add value to your home, and adding a railing can further enhance its appeal. A stylish and durable railing can make your deck stand out from others while making it more desirable to potential buyers if you ever decide to sell your home. Adding a guardrail to your deck-building project should be considered a home investment that can pay off in the long run.
3. A Railing Enhances A Deck's Aesthetic

Railings come in a wide range of styles, colors, and materials, making it easy to find one that complements your deck's design. Whether you prefer the sleek lines of modern steel or the rustic charm of wood, there's a railing to suit your taste.
This element can help tie your deck's design together, creating a cohesive and polished look. Choose a railing that complements your deck's style and enhances its overall aesthetic appeal.
4. Adding a Railing Gives More Privacy

It can provide privacy if your deck is close to your neighbor's property or a busy street. Adding a taller bar or one with privacy screens can create a sense of seclusion and make your deck feel like a private oasis. This can be especially beneficial if you enjoy spending time on your deck but want to avoid feeling exposed to the outside world.

This element provides a designated outdoor living area, making your deck feel like an extension of your home. It can make your deck a more functional space for entertaining, relaxing, or spending time with family and friends. Adding it creates a clear boundary between your deck and the rest of your outdoor space, which can help you make the most of your deck's potential.
5. A Railing Improves Child Safety

The safer, the better. According to the Consumer Product Safety Commission , falls from elevated surfaces like decks are one of the leading causes of injury among children. Adding it to your deck can help prevent these accidents by creating a physical barrier children can't easily climb over.
6. Get A Railing For Pest Prevention

If your deck is made of hardwood or high-quality composite, you may ignore this fact , as they are pests-resistant. But, if your deck is made of any other material, and you live in an area with a lot of wildlife or pests, a railing can help keep larger animals away.
7. Add A Railing For Wind Protection
A railing can protect you from a windy day. This barrier can help block wind and keep your outdoor space more comfortable.

In conclusion, adding it to your deck is a smart and practical investment. Not only does it provide safety and increase your property value, but it can also enhance your deck's aesthetic appeal. With so many styles and materials to choose from, it can be customized to suit any deck design. Plus, it gives you more privacy for outdoor activities. So if you're building a deck, remember to include it in your plans. It's a decision you won't regret.

blocks.text: It is clear that they are the best building material, so with our Platinum Wood Premium Collection , we are offering you the best from the best. Here is a summary of the most important facts about each hardwood from this unique collection.
Ipe Wood

It is a dense and durable wood with a Janka hardness rating of 3684, making it one of the hardest and most durable woods available. Ipe has a fine-to-medium texture and a straight to irregular grain, with a rich dark brown color that darkens over time.

One of the most notable features of Ipe is its resistance to decay, rot, and insects. It is also naturally fire-resistant, making it an excellent choice for outdoor projects such as decks, boardwalks, and outdoor furniture.

Ipe is so much more, as it is the best species from these extraordinary hardwoods. It is low maintenance, resistant to seawater, does not heat up in the sun, does not scratch or splinter, and can last for at least 75 years in perfect condition.
Cumaru Wood

Cumaru, also known as Brazilian Teak, is another popular hardwood from South America. It is a dense and durable deck with a Janka hardness rating of 3540, making it one of the hardest woods available. Cumaru has a fine-to-medium texture and a straight to interlocked grain, with a rich golden-brown color varying from light to dark.

Cumaru is naturally resistant to decay, rot, and insects like Ipe. It also repeals water, is fire-resistant, and has a high coefficient of friction too. Its similarity with Ipe makes it the best second choice from these bestsellers.
Garapa Wood

Garapa, also known as Brazilian Oak, is a lighter-colored hardwood from South America. It has a Janka hardness rating of 1210, a medium-to-coarse texture, and a straight to interlocked grain, a light yellow to golden-brown color that darkens over time.
The Garapa deck has a flexural strength of 12,900 psi. This means that it spans greater distances with minimal deflection. With less deflection, deck boards gain more stability.

While Garapa is not as hard as Ipe or Cumaru, it is still a durable and strong wood naturally resistant to decay and insects. Its lighter color and relatively soft texture make it a popular choice for decks, outdoor furniture, and siding.
Jatoba Wood

Jatoba , also known as Brazilian Cherry, is a dense and durable wood with a Janka hardness rating of 2350, making it an excellent option for high-traffic areas. It has a medium-to-coarse texture and a straight to interlocked grain, with a rich reddish-brown color that darkens over time.

This is also naturally resistant to decay and insects, making it an excellent choice for outdoor projects such as decks and siding. Its natural beauty is one of its charms. The intense cherry color of it makes it stand out from the crowd, providing an elegant and sophisticated style.
Tigerwood

Tigerwood, also known as South American zebrawood, is from a tropical tree native primarily to the east coast of Brazil. The unique name "tigerwood" is due to its beautiful contrasting grain pattern and bold stripes, which resemble those of a tiger.

It is one of the strongest, most durable, and densest hardwoods and has a natural sheen. As a result, the cut of it gives it a metallic and oily appearance, considered one of its most attractive features.

Tigerwood is often used for interior floors, musical instruments, and fine furniture. Its durability and water-repellent properties make it perfect for outdoor use, including deck boards, blinds, and boats.

posts.title: Top 10 Reasons For Adding A Hardwood Fence To The Backyard
posts.h1: Top 10 Reasons For Adding A Hardwood Fence To The Backyard

blocks.text: Whether you aim to enhance your property's security and privacy or create a charming backdrop for your Bougainville, a well-designed hardwood fence can serve as the perfect finishing touch to your garden or yard. A hardwood fence provides a sense of enclosure and protection, adds aesthetic appeal, and defines the boundaries of your outdoor space.

With numerous styles, materials, and customization options available, you have the opportunity to create a hardwood fence that complements your unique vision and meets your specific needs. From classic wooden picket fences to modern metal designs, the possibilities are endless.

Our team of experts at Brazilian Lumber can give you the right guidance on the proper materials for a fence according to your needs and style preferences. Regarding the appropriate material for a fence, we recommend our super high-quality tropical hardwoods .

Remember, a fence is not just a boundary; it is THAT finishing touch that adds security and style to your yard. So, buckle up and get ready to unlock the potential of your patio with this versatile item with countless uses. Here are some good reasons for adding a fence to your outdoors.

items: Enhances Privacy
Increases Safety and Security
Boosts Property Value
Creates Boundaries
Wildlife Deterrent
Reduces Maintenance Work
Acts as a Shelter
Creates Zones
Protective Pet Barrier
Design Proposes

blocks.text: 1. A Hardwood Fence Enhances The Privacy Of Your Backyard

Whether you're sunbathing, reading a book, or hosting a family barbecue, a fence allows you to enjoy these activities in privacy. Depending on your specific needs, you can choose from various fences styles from our amazing hardwoods.

Hardwood fences can be much more than functional; they can be a decorative feature too. With a wide range of designs and colors available, you can build the one that complements your home's architectural style and enhances the beauty of your backyard.
2. Increases Safety & Security

The safety of your loved ones and cherished possessions is key for each project we help you to build. A sturdy fence is a physical barrier against unwanted intruders, whether human or animal. For families with children or pets, this feature ensures that they can play freely without the risk of wandering away or encountering stray animals.
3. Boosts Property Value

A well-maintained fence can significantly increase your property's market value. Potential buyers often perceive a fenced backyard as valuable due to its privacy, security, and aesthetic benefits. Therefore, investing in a fence can yield a substantial return when it's time to sell your home.
4. Creates Boundaries

A fence demarcates your property, eliminating potential disputes with neighbors regarding property lines. It also helps protect your garden or lawn from being trampled by stray animals or careless passersby.
5. Wildlife Deterrent

In addition to its aesthetic contribution to the backyard, a fence is an item of protection for the garden. It acts as a natural deterrent to wildlife, preventing damage to your green space. Whether you're trying to keep out rabbits, deer, or stray cats, a fence can help safeguard your yard.
6. Reduces Maintenance Work
A fence can simplify yard maintenance. It helps prevent leaves or trash from neighboring areas from entering your yard, reducing the time you have to spend cleaning up.
7. A Fence Can Act As A Shelter

Covered and secured. A fence can provide a degree of protection against elements such as wind or snow. For instance, solid bars can act as windbreakers, protecting your plants and making your backyard a more comfortable place to hang out, even on breezy days.
8. Create Zones With A Fence

In larger backyards, a fence can delineate different areas or 'zones' for different purposes. You could have a fenced-off place for dining, a children's play area, and another for gardening. This item helps to organize the space better and can make it more functional and enjoyable.
9. Protective Pet Barrier

If you have pets, a fence is almost a necessity. It will keep your dogs or cats safe and secure in your backyard, giving them the freedom to play and explore without the risk of running off. It is also a responsible choice, preventing your pets from becoming a neighborhood nuisance.
10. Use It For Design Purposes

A fence can be a backdrop or a canvas for other design elements. You can hang planters, lights, or decorative items on it. You can use the fence to create a vertical garden with a green thumb. It's an opportunity to give some character to your outdoors.
Made A Hardwood Fence For The Backyard

If you're considering adding a hardwood fence to your backyard, hardwood is a material worth serious consideration. Known for its exceptional durability and timeless beauty, choosing this material for building a fence is an investment that pays off in the short and long term.

Hardwood fences emanate a sense of warmth and sophistication that is hard to replicate. Hardwood fences seamlessly blend into any landscape and add a touch of natural elegance to your backyard. Their rich tones, unique grain patterns, and smooth textures create a visually captivating boundary that enhances the appeal of your outdoor space, especially when choosing any of our premium species: Ipe , Cumaru , Garapa , Jatoba , and Tigerwood .

But the advantages of hardwood go beyond aesthetics. When it comes to durability, hardwood stands in a league of its own. This material is naturally resistant to external hazards such as pests, rot, and harsh weather conditions, making it an excellent choice for fencing. Furthermore, hardwood fences are sturdy and robust, providing high security and privacy for your backyard.

Maintenance is also quite straightforward. A hardwood fence can last decades, with proper care , retaining its beauty and structural integrity. While the initial cost may be higher than some other materials, the longevity of hardwoods makes it a cost-effective choice in the long run.
Important Considerations When Building A Fence
While hardwood fences are generally straightforward outdoor additions, several important aspects need thoughtful consideration before installation.

One crucial element is understanding the rules and regulations about fence installation, which can vary greatly depending on your location and specific circumstances. Various parameters, such as your fence's setback from the street, sidewalk, or property line, may be subject to specific requirements.

Additionally, the fence's height, the material used, and even its design might be regulated. For instance, stipulations could establish that the more appealing side of a fence should face the street or neighboring properties.

Properties situated on corner lots may face additional restrictions related to visibility. Suppose your property is adjacent to conservation land or within a historic district. In that case, it might be subject to unique limitations. It's essential to consult your local building department or the appropriate authorities to grasp the exact rules and regulations related to fence installation in your area.

Furthermore, properties housing an "attractive nuisance," such as a pool, are typically subject to specific local codes related to fencing, gates, and materials. To ensure you meet all necessary guidelines, contact your local building department or planning authority for proper advice.

As we pull back the curtain on our insightful journey through the world of backyard fencing, a fence is, in fact, a key piece in shaping your outdoor space. A hardwood fence is a multi-faceted element, capable of transforming your backyard from a simple open area into heaven, a private retreat, an aesthetic feature, and a tangible asset.
So, whether planning a backyard revamp or simply pondering ways to improve your outdoor living, remember to give the fence the attention it deserves.

From privacy to aesthetics, safety to property value, the benefits of a fence are wide-ranging and significant. So, don't sideline the fence in your backyard plans; it could be the defining feature that takes your outdoor space from good to simply extraordinary. After all, good fences make good backyards!

posts.title: The 3 Best Decking Materials For A Hot Weather
posts.h1: The 3 Best Decking Materials For A Hot Weather

blocks.text: Decking materials, chosen carefully, ensure summer comfort, not a heat-filled snare! When it comes to summertime, nothing beats the peace and relaxation of lounging on your deck. But when the temperature rises, not all decking materials are created equal. Choosing the right material for a deck is a crucial decision for residents of hot weather regions.

This choice can mean the difference between a comfortable outdoor oasis and a blisteringly hot surface that's barely usable. Fortunately, there are decking materials specifically designed not to retain heat, providing a cooler surface even in the peak of summer. And the best part is that here at Brazilian Lumber, we have THE PERFECT options for you.

items: Hardwoods
Composites
PVC

blocks.text: 1. Best Decking Materials For Hot Weather: Hardwoods

Hardwoods are an exceptional choice for decking in hot weather, primarily due to their inherent resistance to heat absorption. Their natural characteristics allow them to stay cool to the touch even in the most scorching temperatures, ensuring a comfortable surface for you to enjoy all summer long.

In addition to their cool nature, hardwoods offer remarkable durability, able to withstand intense, relentless sunshine without warping or fading. These dense woods are also naturally resistant to scratching and splintering, ensuring a smooth and safe decking surface. Couple this with their natural water resistance, and you have a decking material designed to survive and thrive in hot climates.

In this category, we have the best of the best decking material. Our tropical hardwoods are the premium choice you were looking for. Choose from our Ipe , Cumaru , Garapa , Jatoba or Tigerwood , and be amazed at the results.
2. Best Decking Materials For Hot Weather: Composites

Composite decking materials are a stellar choice for hot weather climates, thanks to their specially engineered qualities. Manufactured from a blend of wood and plastic, these materials are designed to resist heat absorption, keeping the deck surface cool even under the harshest sun. The durability of composites is another huge plus; they are crafted to endure the elements, ensuring a long-lasting deck despite constant exposure to intense sunlight.

The maintenance requirements are also minimal, making them an easy-care choice for busy homeowners. Furthermore, composites are water-resistant and do not scratch or splinter, providing a consistently safe, comfortable surface for summertime relaxation. Their versatility in design and color adds the final touch to their appeal, allowing customers to achieve the desired design while enjoying the cool comfort of their deck.

At Brazilian Lumber, we offer various amazing composite options, but in this article, we want to make Moisture Shield the spotlight of this category. Using advanced technology, this brand recently developed a composite decking designed to beat the heat.

This technology improvement absorbs up to 35% of the heat to stay cooler under the hot summer sun. This brand, from which we are authorized distributors, is the first one offering this heat-resistant composite decking innovation that can help you create more comfortable outdoor environments all season long.
3. Best Decking Materials For Hot Weather: PVC

PVC is also a good alternative when choosing the proper material for decking when summer feels eternal. These decking boards are made of synthetic decking materials, without wood shavings or by-products. Its boards are made of recycled polyethylene or polyvinyl chloride.

It's immune to the harmful effects of moisture, resisting mold, rot, and water damage like a true champion. The sun's scorching rays? No problem! PVC doesn't warp, fade, or crack under heat. With PVC decking, there's no need for a rigorous maintenance schedule - a simple sweep and occasional wash keep it looking as good as new. Plus, its palette of colors and finishes lets you transform your outdoor space into anything from a chic, modern lounge to a vibrant, playful retreat.

We are authorized distributors of a few fantastic PVC brands, but to provide just one example, let's talk about TimberTech. This brand offers advanced PVC decking specially designed to remain cool to the touch, even when exposed to direct sunlight. It incorporates cutting-edge materials science within its core and cap, granting it superior heat resistance compared to other composite decking products.

As you can see, in terms of durability, maintenance, and not heat retention, hardwoods, composites, and PVC options are pretty much alike. At Brazilian Lumber , we offer the best from all these decking materials for stunning decking projects. Ipe , Cumaru , or any of our composites or PVC alternatives truly know how to transform common spaces into extraordinary places. Here are some of their most impressive features.

items: No heat retention
Durability
Low Maintenance
Water resistance
Do not scratch or splinter
Aesthetic Versatility

blocks.text: Hardwoods, Composites, and PVC Do Not Get Hot Underfoot

The primary concern for decking in hot weather is heat retention. Decking materials that retain heat will become uncomfortably hot to walk on. Hardwoods, composites, and PVC alternatives are superior in this regard. Hardwoods, such as Ipe, Cumaru, and Teak, naturally stay cooler because they don't hold as much heat. Similarly, composites, being a mix of wood and plastic, are engineered to resist heat absorption. Their heat dissipation qualities ensure that your deck will stay cool to the touch even on the hottest days, so don't worry about burning your feet. PVC alternatives also have a suitable composition for no retaining heat.

When it comes to synthetic deckings, color plays a significant role in the heat absorption of composites. Darker colors tend to absorb more heat compared to lighter colors. However, this distinction is less pronounced in polyvinyl decks because the heat is not fully absorbed. While there is a slight variation in the peak temperature between darker and lighter-color PVC products, it is not as prominent as in decking materials.

Decks are an investment, and you want your investment to last. Durability is a significant factor, and hardwoods, composites, and PVC deckings excel in this area. Hardwoods are naturally dense and resistant to wear and tear. At the same time, composites and PVC alternatives are designed to withstand the elements, providing a long-lasting solution.
2. These Decking Materials Are Low Maintenance

Minimal maintenance is another key advantage of these decking materials. Hardwoods require occasional oiling to maintain their color but otherwise require little upkeep. Composites and PVC deckings, on the other hand, require virtually no maintenance beyond regular cleaning.

Water resistance is an essential characteristic of decking in hot climates. Hot weather often means dry conditions, but when it does rain, you don't want your deck to suffer. Hardwoods have natural oils that repel water, and composites and PVC alternatives are manufactured to be water-resistant, preventing moisture absorption and related damage.
4. Do not scratch or splinter

Nothing spoils the enjoyment of a beautiful deck faster than a painful splinter. Hardwoods, due to their density, and composites & PVC alternatives, due to their manufacturing process, resist scratching and splintering, ensuring a smooth and safe surface.

Besides a strong structure, a stunning appearance is important when building a project. Luckily, our decking material alternatives offer a wide range of aesthetic options to meet any design preference.

Hardwoods offer a classic, timeless look with rich colors and natural grains. Each piece of wood has unique patterns, meaning every deck will look different. With hardwoods, you can achieve a range of styles, from rustic to elegant.

Likewise, composites and PVC alternatives also offer incredible versatility. Decking materials can be manufactured to look like wood or even stone. Plus, they come in a wide range of colors and finishes, allowing you to customize the look of your deck to match your home and personal style.
Choose Sustainable Decking Materials

Today, many homeowners are more conscious than ever about the environmental impact of their choices. In terms of decking materials, both hardwoods and composites have environmentally friendly features worth considering.

Many types of hardwood used for decking come from sustainably managed forests. This means that for each tree cut down, another is planted in its place, ensuring our planet's forests' continued health and alive. Furthermore, because hardwoods are natural and long-lasting, they don't contribute to landfill waste as quickly as other materials might.
This is an essential characteristic of most of our tropical hardwoods, as they are sourced from a sustainable harvesting process and are FSC certified.

Additionally, composites are made from recycled wood fibers and plastics, reducing the demand for new timber and keeping plastic waste out of our landfills. Moreover, composite decks have a long lifespan, minimizing their environmental footprint.

Summertime is for relaxing, not for dealing with a scorching hot deck or worrying about maintenance and damage. With hardwood, composite, or PVC decking, you can enjoy a fresh, comfortable deck, even in the peak of summer. These decking materials stay cooler under the sun and offer durability, low maintenance, water resistance, and a smooth, splinter-free surface.

Creating the perfect deck for summertime is not just about aesthetics; it's about choosing materials to make your outdoor living space enjoyable and comfortable, no matter how high the temperature soars. So, whether you're planning a new deck or considering a renovation, remember to keep it cool with the right decking material. Keep in mind that the best summer stories are told on a cool, comfortable deck. Make your deck the place to be this summer!

blocks.text: In today's fast-paced world, finding moments of tranquility and relaxation becomes increasingly vital for our overall well-being. Fortunately, having an outdoor spot and immersing ourselves in nature's embrace can offer us much more than just fresh air. From stress relief to improved physical health, enhanced mental well-being, increased social interaction, and even a creativity and productivity boost, there's no denying the power of spending time in an outdoor sanctuary. So, let's dive into these five incredible benefits and discover why having an outdoor spot can truly be a game-changer for our lives.

At Brazilian Lumber , we have all the products and services to accomplish your dream project and transform your backyard into heaven. Our premium quality tropical hardwoods , composites , and PVC alternatives, combined with our experience and prompt service, will make your life wonderful just a call away.

Among the variety of materials we carry, we have all the hardware you need to build the project of your dreams. From decks, docks, fences, and pergolas to ceilings, siding, and even decorative elements like live edge slabs. We have the best materials for building pretty much anything you have in mind.

But why do you need an outdoor spot? A wealth of scientific research backs the advantages of having an outdoor space. A study published in the International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health found that time spent in green spaces can help reduce stress, improve mood, and improve psychological well-being (Twohig-Bennett & Jones, 2018).

Likewise, a report from the University of Exeter Medical School showed that people living in neighborhoods with more green spaces reported less mental distress and higher life satisfaction (White et al., 2013). Nature's influence goes beyond mere aesthetics - it can profoundly transform our health, happiness, and overall quality of life.

Another study from the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health and Brigham and Women's Hospital found that women living in areas with the most green spaces had a 12% lower death rate than those living in the least green areas (James et al., 2016). This suggests an outdoor spot could contribute to a longer and healthier life.

Furthermore, a study published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences showed that children with more nature exposure exhibited better cognitive development (Dadvand et al., 2015). This could suggest that having an outdoor spot is beneficial for adults and plays a crucial role in a child's cognitive development.

Last but not least, a study conducted at the University of Michigan found that spending a few minutes walking in nature could improve memory and attention by 20% (Berman et al., 2008). This shows how an outdoor spot could be a productivity booster, particularly for those working or studying from home.
These studies collectively provide compelling evidence of the far-reaching benefits of having an outdoor spot. However, we listed the most important advantages of being outdoors.
Advantages Of An Outdoor Spot

items: Stress Relief
Improved Physical Health
Enhanced Mental Wellbeing
Increased Social Interaction
Creativity and Productivity Boost

blocks.text: 1. An Outdoor Spot Relieves Stress:
The tranquility of an outdoor spot can be an effective stress buster. Being surrounded by nature helps decrease the production of cortisol, a stress hormone, making you feel more relaxed and calm.
2. Improved Physical Health:

Having a place to enjoy nature provides regular exposure to sunlight, which increases vitamin D levels. This vitamin strengthens bones and boosts the immune system. Furthermore, outdoor activities can improve cardiovascular health and enhance overall fitness levels.
3. Enhanced Mental Well-being:
Spending time outdoors is like a balm for the mind. A quiet, outdoor space helps reduce anxiety and depression, improves mood, and increases happiness and contentment.
4. Increased Social Interaction:

An outdoor spot serves as a social hub, a place for family gatherings, friendly barbecues, and intimate conversations under the stars. Such social interactions contribute to improved mental health and a sense of community.
5. Creativity and Productivity Boost:

The natural environment of an outdoor spot can stimulate creativity and improve concentration. It provides a serene atmosphere free from distractions, making it an ideal space for reading, writing, or working.
Conclusion

In summary, having an outdoor spot is not just a luxury; it's a gateway to a healthier, happier life. It invites us to pause, breathe, and soak in the beauty of nature. It encourages us to move, play, and connect with others. Whether it's a lush garden, a cozy patio, a simple balcony, or a stunning backyard with potted plants, an outdoor spot is an invaluable sanctuary that offers many benefits.
So go outside and embrace nature: a world of joy, health, and happiness awaits you. And you know what's even better? We have all the products you need to create the outdoor space of your dreams.

posts.title: Top 5 Benefits of a Customized Milling Profile Service
posts.h1: Top 5 Benefits of a Customized Milling Profile Service

blocks.text: At Brazilian Lumber , we offer a wide range of materials to build all kinds of projects, primarily for the outdoors but also for indoors. We are direct importers of tropical hardwoods and have amazing composites alternatives and all the hardware you need for construction. But one of our main advantages is our customized milling service. This allows us to provide all kinds of profiles with common or specific characteristics, a service with incredible benefits.

Customized milling, which consists of shaping and forming lumber to exact specifications, is not merely a process but a commitment to precision, quality, and versatility. We offer a variety of standard milling profiles, including:

items:
V-Joint Customized Milling

V-joint milling is a technique used to create a V-shaped groove along the length of the decking boards. The V-joint creates a distinct shadow line between each board, adding visual interest and depth to the decking surface. This milling technique is often used in traditional or rustic decking designs. Learn more about it in this video .

Rainscreen Customized Milling

It is a method used to create a channel or groove on the backside of the decking boards. These channels allow for proper airflow and drainage between the decking surface and the underlying structure. Rain screen milling helps prevent moisture buildup, reduces the risk of rot or decay, and enhances the longevity of the decking material.

Shiplap Customized Milling

Shiplap milling involves creating a distinctive profile where the edges of the decking boards overlap with a rabbet joint. The rabbet joint creates a groove on one side and a corresponding ridge on the other side, allowing the boards to fit snugly together. Shiplap milling provides a tight, weather-resistant joint, adding a rustic or coastal charm to the decking.

blocks.text: Each of these milling techniques offers unique characteristics and visual effects, allowing you to achieve different styles and aesthetics for your decking project. It's important to consider the specific requirements and design preferences when selecting the appropriate milling technique for your decking materials.
